# TheorieTrainer — volledige broncode

Automatisch samengestelde momentopname van de projectbestanden, gemaakt met `python3 tools/code-bundle.py`. De losse bronbestanden in de map blijven de bewerkbare projectversie. Niet opgenomen: foto's (JPG/PNG), de video's in `Nutheorie_Videos/`, `extra/auto-theorie-oefentoets.html` (bevat ingebedde afbeeldingen) en de mappen `_archief/` en `dist/`.

## style.css

```
/* Nu Theorie — a quiet, accessible place to get ready for the road. */
:root {
  color-scheme: light;
  --bg: #f6f7f9;
  --surface: #fff;
  --surface-soft: #f8f9fc;
  --text: #19253d;
  --muted: #5f6a80;
  --subtle: #5f6a80;
  --line: #e9ecf2;
  --primary: #3459e6;
  --primary-hover: #2647ce;
  --primary-soft: #edf1ff;
  --green: #18795f;
  --green-soft: #e8f7ef;
  --orange: #9b5e25;
  --orange-soft: #fff2e4;
  --purple: #8c6cd8;
  --purple-soft: #f1edfc;
  --pink: #cf7395;
  --pink-soft: #fcebf2;
  --teal: #408f9a;
  --teal-soft: #e7f5f5;
  --yellow: #b48d2d;
  --yellow-soft: #fff7dc;
  --danger: #bd3e49;
  --danger-soft: #fff0f1;
  --shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(29, 45, 78, .035);
  --radius: 20px;
  --header-height: 78px;
}

html[data-theme="dark"] {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --bg: #111724;
  --surface: #1a2233;
  --surface-soft: #202a3d;
  --text: #edf1fc;
  --muted: #a7b1c6;
  --subtle: #94a1b8;
  --line: #2a3549;
  --primary: #8aa3ff;
  --primary-hover: #a6b9ff;
  --primary-soft: #273455;
  --green: #79d3b4;
  --green-soft: #203d36;
  --orange: #efb578;
  --orange-soft: #44352b;
  --purple: #bfa7fa;
  --purple-soft: #362f4d;
  --pink: #e7a0be;
  --pink-soft: #432d3d;
  --teal: #8bced3;
  --teal-soft: #213d45;
  --yellow: #e2c26e;
  --yellow-soft: #423e2a;
  --danger: #ff9ba2;
  --danger-soft: #442c37;
  --shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-top: 96px; }
body { margin: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
body.dialog-open { overflow: hidden; }
button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; }
button, a, input, select, summary { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
button { color: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
button:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }
button, input, select { touch-action: manipulation; }
a { color: var(--primary); text-decoration: none; }
a:hover { text-decoration: none; }
button, a, input, select, textarea, summary { outline: none; }
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 4px; }
h1[tabindex="-1"]:focus, #question-text:focus { outline: none; }
::selection { color: var(--text); background: #cbd7ff; }
h1, h2, h3, h4, p { margin: 0; }
h1, h2, h3, h4 { font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -.035em; }
h1 { font-size: 34px; }
h2 { font-size: 23px; }
h3 { font-size: 17px; }
img, svg { max-width: 100%; }
img { display: block; }
hr { height: 1px; background: var(--line); border: 0; }
.icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: 0 0 auto; vertical-align: middle; }
.sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }
.hidden, [hidden] { display: none !important; }
.skip-link { position: fixed; top: -70px; left: 24px; z-index: 200; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 10px; color: #fff; background: #3459e6; }
.skip-link:focus { top: 12px; }

.site-header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 40; height: var(--header-height); background: var(--surface); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.header-inner { max-width: 1320px; height: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 28px; }
.brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--text); flex-shrink: 0; }
.brand-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 39px; height: 39px; color: #fff; background: #3459e6; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px #3459e61a; }
.brand-icon .icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
.brand-text { font-size: 21px; font-weight: 760; letter-spacing: -.9px; line-height: 1.15; }
.brand-text > span:not(.brand-tag) { color: var(--primary); }
.brand-tag { display: block; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.4; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 2.1px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.main-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 100%; }
.nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 41px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; transition: background .16s, color .16s; }
.nav-link .icon { width: 17px; height: 17px; }
.nav-link:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--surface-soft); }
.nav-link.active { color: var(--primary); background: var(--primary-soft); }
.header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.icon-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 11px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--muted); transition: color .16s, border-color .16s, background .16s; }
.icon-button:hover { background: var(--surface-soft); color: var(--primary); border-color: var(--primary); }
.menu-toggle { display: none; }
.app-main { min-height: calc(100vh - 188px); }
/* De footer verschijnt pas als de pagina is opgebouwd, zodat hij bij laden niet verspringt. */
.app-main:has(> #view:empty) + .footer { display: none; }
.page-container { width: min(1240px, calc(100% - 80px)); margin: 0 auto; padding: 31px 0 54px; }
#view { animation: appear .2s ease-out; }
.dashboard-topline { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 22px; gap: 12px; }
.breadcrumb { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.breadcrumb .icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.streak-chip { display: inline-flex; gap: 7px; align-items: center; padding: 5px 10px; background: var(--orange-soft); color: var(--orange); border-radius: 7px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; }
.streak-chip .icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.page-heading { margin-bottom: 28px; }
.eyebrow { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--primary); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: 1.7px; text-transform: uppercase; }
.page-description { margin-top: 11px; color: var(--muted); max-width: 660px; }

.button { min-height: 46px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; padding: 12px 21px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.4; text-align: center; transition: background .16s, border-color .16s, box-shadow .16s, transform .16s; }
.button:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-1px); }
.button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0); }
.button.primary { background: #3459e6; color: #fff; border-color: #3459e6; box-shadow: 0 4px 9px #3459e61c; }
.button.primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #2647ce; border-color: #2647ce; box-shadow: 0 6px 14px #3459e629; }
.button.secondary { background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); border-color: var(--line); }
.button.secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--primary); }
.button.ghost { color: var(--muted); background: transparent; }
.button.ghost:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--surface-soft); color: var(--text); }
.button.danger { color: var(--danger); background: var(--danger-soft); border-color: transparent; }
.button.danger:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--danger); }
.button.small { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 13px; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 8px; }
.button .icon { width: 17px; height: 17px; }
.text-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: none; border: 0; padding: 9px 0 9px 9px; color: var(--primary); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; }
.text-button:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }
.text-button .icon { width: 15px; height: 15px; }

.hero { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 1fr; align-items: stretch; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 23px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.hero-copy { padding: 39px 18px 37px 38px; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.hero-kicker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin-bottom: 19px; padding: 5px 9px; background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--primary); border-radius: 6px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .3px; }
.live-dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; background: currentColor; border-radius: 50%; }
.hero h1 { max-width: 530px; font-size: clamp(35px, 3.6vw, 48px); letter-spacing: -2px; line-height: 1.15; }
.accent { color: var(--primary); }
.hero-description { max-width: 430px; margin-top: 17px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8; }
.hero-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-top: 25px; }
.hero-proof { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px 15px; margin-top: 21px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; }
.hero-proof span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.hero-proof .icon { flex: 0 0 auto; }
.hero-proof .icon { width: 13px; height: 13px; color: var(--green); }
.hero-art { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 0; padding: 24px 21px 20px 5px; overflow: hidden; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 52% 51%, #eaf0ff 0, #f5f7ff 57%, #fff 78%); }
.hero-art > svg { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 480px; height: auto; max-height: 325px; overflow: visible; }
.art-caption { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: -2px; color: #8290aa; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .3px; }
html[data-theme="dark"] .hero-art { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 52% 51%, #273756 0, #1c283c 57%, #1a2233 78%); }
.stats-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 16px; margin-top: 23px; }
.stat-card { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 43px 1fr; column-gap: 13px; align-items: center; padding: 22px 20px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 15px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.stat-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 43px; height: 43px; border-radius: 12px; grid-row: 1 / 4; }
.stat-value { color: var(--text); font-size: 25px; font-weight: 750; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -.8px; }
.stat-value small { margin-left: 2px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 550; letter-spacing: -.3px; }
.stat-label { margin-top: 4px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }
.stat-note { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--green); font-size: 10px; }
.blue { color: var(--primary); background: var(--primary-soft); }
.green { color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); }
.orange { color: var(--orange); background: var(--orange-soft); }
.purple { color: var(--purple); background: var(--purple-soft); }
.pink { color: var(--pink); background: var(--pink-soft); }
.teal { color: var(--teal); background: var(--teal-soft); }
.yellow { color: var(--yellow); background: var(--yellow-soft); }
.slate { color: #7387a5; background: #edf1f7; }
html[data-theme="dark"] .slate { color: #b7c5dd; background: #2c374d; }
.section-space { margin-top: 36px; }
.section-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 19px; }
.section-title h2, .section-header h2 { font-size: 21px; }
.section-subtitle { margin-top: 5px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.category-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
.category-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; padding: 21px 20px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); text-align: left; box-shadow: var(--shadow); transition: border-color .17s, box-shadow .17s, transform .17s; }
.category-card:hover { border-color: #bac8f9; transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 8px 25px #253f8010; }
.category-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 17px; }
.category-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 12px; }
.category-icon .icon { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
.category-count { color: var(--subtle); font-size: 10px; }
.category-card h3 { font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: -.3px; }
.category-description { min-height: 36px; margin-top: 7px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.7; }
.category-footer { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 10px; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 18px; }
.progress-track { height: 4px; overflow: hidden; flex: 1; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--line); }
.progress-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--primary); transition: width .3s; }
.category-percent { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; text-align: left; }
.category-footer > .progress-track { flex: none; width: 100%; }
.category-action { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 0 0; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--primary); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
.category-action:hover { color: var(--text); }
.category-action .icon { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.dashboard-bottom { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.7fr 1fr; gap: 20px; margin-top: 30px; }
.panel { padding: 25px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.panel h2 { font-size: 18px; }
.panel .section-header { margin-bottom: 18px; }
.panel .section-subtitle { font-size: 11px; }
.daily-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 15px; padding: 24px; background: var(--primary-soft); border: 1px solid #dce4ff; border-radius: var(--radius); }
.daily-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 42px; height: 42px; color: var(--primary); background: var(--surface); border-radius: 12px; }
.daily-badge { display: inline-flex; align-self: flex-start; padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--primary); background: var(--surface); border-radius: 6px; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .7px; text-transform: uppercase; }
.daily-copy h3 { margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 18px; }
.daily-copy p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.75; }
.daily-card > h2 { font-size: 25px; letter-spacing: -.8px; }
.daily-card > p { max-width: 300px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.75; }
.daily-note { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; }
.daily-note .icon { width: 13px; height: 13px; }
.daily-card .button { align-self: flex-start; margin-top: 2px; }
html[data-theme="dark"] .daily-card { border-color: var(--line); }
.empty-state { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 175px; padding: 24px; color: var(--muted); text-align: center; }
.empty-state h3 { color: var(--text); font-size: 15px; }
.empty-state p { max-width: 350px; font-size: 12px; }
.empty-icon { width: 42px; height: 42px; display: grid; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 3px; color: var(--subtle); background: var(--surface-soft); border-radius: 50%; }
.empty-state .button { margin-top: 7px; }
.empty-state.compact { min-height: 245px; padding: 25px 16px; }
.empty-state.compact .empty-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; margin-bottom: 7px; }
.dashboard-caption { padding: 39px 0 2px; color: var(--subtle); text-align: center; }
.dashboard-caption h2 { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; }
.dashboard-caption p { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 10px; }
.recent-list { display: grid; }
.recent-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; padding: 16px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.recent-item:last-child { border-bottom: 0; padding-bottom: 0; }
.recent-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--primary); border-radius: 10px; }
.recent-copy { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-size: 13px; }
.recent-copy strong { display: block; font-weight: 600; }
.recent-copy span, .recent-copy small { display: block; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; }
.recent-score { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--green); white-space: nowrap; }
.footer { background: var(--surface); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.footer-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; max-width: 1320px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px 40px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; }
.footer-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; }
.footer-links a, .footer-links button { border: 0; padding: 5px 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; background: transparent; }
.footer-links a:hover, .footer-links button:hover { color: var(--primary); }
.footer-dot { padding: 0 7px; color: var(--subtle); }

.setup-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.6fr) minmax(280px, 1fr); align-items: start; gap: 24px; }
.setup-card { padding: 30px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.setup-card h2 { margin-bottom: 22px; font-size: 20px; }
.form-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 22px; }
.field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 22px; min-width: 0; }
.form-grid .field { margin-bottom: 0; }
.field label, .field > span, .field > legend { padding: 0; color: var(--text); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; }
.field fieldset, fieldset.field { border: 0; padding: 0; min-width: 0; }
.field small, .field-hint { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }
input:not([type="checkbox"]):not([type="radio"]), select, textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 13px; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; }
input::placeholder, textarea::placeholder { color: var(--subtle); }
input:not([type="checkbox"]):not([type="radio"]):focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--primary); }
input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"] { width: 18px; height: 18px; accent-color: #3459e6; cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0; }
.segmented-options { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 9px; }
.count-fieldset { min-width: 0; margin: 25px 0 20px; padding: 0; border: 0; }
.count-fieldset legend { margin-bottom: 10px; padding: 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; }
.choice-button { flex: 1; min-width: 60px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }
.choice-button > span { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 450; }
.choice-button:hover { border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--primary); }
.choice-button.selected { background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--primary); border-color: var(--primary); }
.checkbox-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; min-height: 44px; margin: 15px 0; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; }
.checkbox-row input { margin: 0; }
.checkbox-row > span > strong { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; }
.checkbox-row > span > strong .icon { width: 15px; height: 15px; color: var(--primary); }
.checkbox-row > span > span { display: block; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; }
.setup-summary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; margin-top: 27px; padding-top: 23px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.setup-summary:has(> .icon) { align-items: flex-start; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 9px; margin-bottom: 23px; }
.setup-summary > .icon { width: 17px; height: 17px; margin-top: 2px; }
.info-card { padding: 26px; background: var(--primary-soft); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); }
.info-card > .category-icon, .exam-setup > .category-icon { margin-bottom: 20px; }
.info-card h2, .info-card h3 { margin-bottom: 15px; font-size: 18px; }
.info-card > p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }
.info-card > p + p { margin-top: 15px; }
.info-card > .text-button { margin-top: 16px; padding-left: 0; white-space: normal; }
.exam-setup > h2 { margin-bottom: 12px; font-size: 24px; }
.exam-setup > p { max-width: 520px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }
.exam-facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 16px; margin: 27px 0 25px; padding: 23px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.exam-facts > div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
.exam-facts strong { font-size: 29px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -1px; line-height: 1.2; }
.exam-facts strong small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.3px; }
.exam-facts > div > span { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }
.info-list { display: grid; gap: 15px; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.info-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.info-row .icon { margin-top: 2px; width: 17px; height: 17px; color: var(--primary); }
.info-row strong { color: var(--text); font-weight: 650; }
.source-note { margin-top: 19px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.7; }
.source-note a { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.source-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; min-height: 32px; margin-top: 8px; color: var(--primary); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }
.source-link .icon { width: 13px; height: 13px; }
.source-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }

.quiz-container { max-width: 860px; margin: 0 auto; }
.quiz-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 19px; }
.quiz-title { font-size: 19px; letter-spacing: -.5px; }
.quiz-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 15px; margin: 4px 0 10px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.quiz-meta > strong { color: var(--text); font-weight: 650; }
.quiz-meta > strong > span { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; }
.timer { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 96px; padding: 9px 13px; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 650; }
.timer.urgent { color: var(--danger); background: var(--danger-soft); border-color: var(--danger); }
.quiz-progress { height: 5px; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 22px; background: var(--line); border-radius: 5px; }
.quiz-progress > div, .quiz-progress > span { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--primary); border-radius: inherit; transition: width .2s; }
.quiz-progress > .progress-track { background: var(--line); }
.question-card { padding: 31px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.question-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.question-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.question-subcategory { margin-bottom: 10px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 650; }
.pill:not(.blue):not(.orange):not(.green) { color: var(--muted); background: var(--surface-soft); }
.pill .icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.question-tools { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.favorite-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 40px; min-width: 40px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--surface); font-size: 12px; }
.favorite-button:hover { border-color: var(--orange); color: var(--orange); }
.favorite-button.active { color: var(--orange); background: var(--orange-soft); border-color: var(--orange); }
.favorite-button.active .icon { fill: currentColor; }
.question-text { margin: 0 0 23px; font-size: 23px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.45; letter-spacing: -.6px; }
.question-image { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 750px; overflow: hidden; margin: 0 auto 24px; background: var(--surface-soft); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; }
.question-image img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; aspect-ratio: 8 / 5; object-fit: contain; background: #dce8db; }
.question-image figcaption { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 2px 12px; padding: 6px 14px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }
.image-zoom-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 44px; padding: 4px 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--primary); font: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }
.image-zoom-button .icon { width: 17px; height: 17px; }
.image-zoom-button:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }
.answer-list { display: grid; gap: 11px; }
.answer-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 66px; width: 100%; padding: 13px 16px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 11px; text-align: left; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; transition: background .15s, border-color .15s; }
.answer-option:hover:not(.locked):not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--primary); background: var(--primary-soft); }
.answer-letter { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 31px; height: 31px; flex: 0 0 auto; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-soft); color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; }
.answer-content { flex: 1; }
.answer-status { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; margin-left: auto; }
.answer-option.selected { border-color: var(--primary); background: var(--primary-soft); }
.answer-option.selected .answer-letter { color: #fff; background: #3459e6; border-color: #3459e6; }
.answer-option.correct { border-color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); }
.answer-option.correct .answer-letter, .answer-option.correct .answer-status { color: var(--green); }
.answer-option.incorrect { border-color: var(--danger); background: var(--danger-soft); }
.answer-option.incorrect .answer-letter, .answer-option.incorrect .answer-status { color: var(--danger); }
.answer-option.locked { cursor: default; }
.answer-option:disabled { opacity: 1; }
.feedback { margin-top: 22px; padding: 19px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 11px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.75; }
.feedback.success { background: var(--green-soft); border-color: var(--green); }
.feedback.error { background: var(--danger-soft); border-color: var(--danger); }
.feedback-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 5px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
.feedback.success .feedback-title { color: var(--green); }
.feedback.error .feedback-title { color: var(--danger); }
.feedback p + p { margin-top: 8px; }
.feedback a { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.quiz-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-top: 23px; }
.question-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; margin-top: 22px; }
.question-nav > span { flex: 1; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; text-align: center; }
.quiz-save-note { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 19px; color: var(--subtle); font-size: 10px; }
.quiz-save-note .icon { width: 12px; height: 12px; }
.question-dots { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; margin: 22px 0 14px; }
.question-dot { width: 32px; min-height: 32px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; }
.question-dot.answered { color: var(--primary); background: var(--primary-soft); border-color: #becbf7; }
.question-dot.current { color: #fff; background: #3459e6; border-color: #3459e6; }
.keyboard-hint { margin-top: 15px; color: var(--subtle); text-align: center; font-size: 10px; }
kbd { padding: 2px 5px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface); font-family: inherit; }

.results-layout { display: grid; gap: 25px; max-width: 960px; margin: 0 auto; }
.results-layout > .page-heading, .results-layout > .section-space, .results-layout > .result-actions { margin: 0; }
.result-hero { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 30px; padding: 33px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--surface); }
.score-ring { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 142px; height: 142px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: conic-gradient(var(--primary) var(--score, 0%), var(--line) 0); }
.score-ring::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface); }
.score-number { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-size: 34px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: -1px; text-align: center; line-height: 1.2; }
.score-number small, .score-number span { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0; }
.score-number small { display: inline; margin: 0 0 0 1px; font-size: 19px; }
.result-summary { flex: 1; }
.result-summary h1 { margin: 8px 0 10px; font-size: 28px; }
.result-summary h2 { margin: 13px 0 10px; font-size: 31px; }
.result-summary h2 > span { color: var(--muted); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.5px; }
.result-summary p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }
.result-facts { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 24px; margin-top: 20px; }
.result-fact { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }
.result-fact .icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.result-fact strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 2px; color: var(--text); font-size: 19px; }
.result-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-top: 22px; }
.category-results { display: grid; gap: 20px; margin-top: 24px; }
.category-result { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42px minmax(0, 1fr) 70px; align-items: center; gap: 16px; font-size: 12px; }
.category-result > div > strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.category-result > span:last-child > strong, .category-result > span:last-child > small { display: block; }
.category-result > span:last-child > strong { color: var(--text); font-size: 14px; }
.category-result > span:last-child > small { margin-top: 3px; font-size: 10px; }
.category-result .progress-track { height: 7px; }
.category-result > :last-child { text-align: right; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }
.review-list { display: grid; gap: 12px; }
.review-card { padding: 18px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); font-size: 13px; }
.review-card summary { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 29px minmax(0, 1fr) 16px; align-items: center; gap: 13px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.6; list-style: none; }
.review-card summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.review-card summary > span:nth-child(2) { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; }
.review-card summary small { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; }
.review-status { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 29px; height: 29px; border-radius: 50%; }
.review-status .icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.review-status.is-correct { color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); }
.review-status.is-incorrect { color: var(--danger); background: var(--danger-soft); }
.review-chevron { color: var(--muted); font-size: 19px; text-align: center; transition: transform .15s; }
.review-card[open] .review-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.review-body { margin-top: 18px; padding: 18px 0 0 42px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.8; }
.review-body p + p { margin-top: 10px; }
.review-body strong { color: var(--text); font-weight: 600; }
.review-body .library-top { margin: 12px 0 0; }
.review-card summary::marker { color: var(--primary); }
.review-card details[open] > summary { margin-bottom: 15px; }
.review-card > p, .review-card details > p { margin-top: 8px; color: var(--muted); }
.review-card .feedback { margin-top: 12px; }
.filter-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 22px; }
.filter-bar > .field { margin: 0; }
.collection-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 25px; }
.search-field { position: relative; flex: 1; min-width: 230px; }
.search-field input { padding-left: 42px !important; }
.search-icon { position: absolute; left: 14px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: var(--subtle); pointer-events: none; }
.search-icon .icon { width: 17px; height: 17px; }
.filter-bar select { width: auto; min-width: 185px; }
.question-list { display: grid; gap: 15px; }
.library-card { padding: 23px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 15px; background: var(--surface); }
.library-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 13px; }
.library-card h2, .library-card h3 { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; letter-spacing: -.3px; }
.library-card > .question-image { margin-top: 19px; }
.library-options { display: grid; gap: 5px; margin: 14px 0; padding-left: 22px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }
.answer-reveal { margin-top: 16px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }
.answer-reveal summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--primary); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; }
.answer-reveal[open] summary { margin-bottom: 12px; }
.answer-reveal p + p { margin-top: 8px; }
.list-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 17px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.pagination { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 26px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.progress-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.3fr 1fr; gap: 22px; margin-top: 25px; }
.chart { display: grid; gap: 19px; margin-top: 25px; }
.chart-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 132px minmax(0, 1fr) 34px 32px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.chart-label { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }
.chart-label small { display: block; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--subtle); font-size: 9px; }
.chart-row .icon-button { width: 32px; height: 35px; border-radius: 8px; }
.chart-row .icon-button .icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.chart-bar { height: 9px; background: var(--line); border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; }
.chart-bar > span, .chart-bar > div { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--primary); border-radius: inherit; }
.chart-bar > .progress-track { background: var(--line); }
.chart-value { color: var(--muted); text-align: right; font-size: 11px; }
.badge-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 13px; margin-top: 23px; }
.achievement { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 18px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--subtle); text-align: center; font-size: 10px; }
.achievement strong { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }
.achievement h3 { font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: -.3px; }
.achievement p { font-size: 11px; }
.achievement > span:last-child { margin-top: 3px; font-size: 9px; }
.achievement-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 41px; height: 41px; background: var(--surface-soft); border-radius: 50%; }
.achievement.unlocked { color: var(--text); background: var(--yellow-soft); border-color: transparent; }
.achievement.unlocked .achievement-icon { color: var(--yellow); background: var(--surface); }
.activity-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 6px; margin-top: 22px; }
.activity-day { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 38px; min-width: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-soft); color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }
.activity-day.active { background: var(--primary); color: var(--surface); }
.activity-legend { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 13px 0 22px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; }
.activity-legend > span { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--primary); }
.settings-panel { max-width: 760px; padding: 29px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); }
.settings-panel + .settings-panel { margin-top: 22px; }
.settings-panel h2 { margin-bottom: 17px; font-size: 19px; }
.settings-panel p { margin-bottom: 17px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }
.settings-panel h3 + p { margin-top: 10px; }
.settings-panel .field { margin-top: 22px; }
.prose h2 { margin-bottom: 14px; }
.prose h3 { margin: 25px 0 11px; font-size: 16px; }
.prose p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.9; }
.prose p + p { margin-top: 13px; }
.source-list { display: grid; }
.source-list a { display: block; padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.source-list a:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; border-bottom: 0; }
.source-list strong { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; }
.source-list .icon { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.source-list a > span { display: block; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }
.source-list a:hover strong { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.notice { margin: 20px 0; padding: 16px 18px; background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--text); border-radius: 11px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.8; }
.notice.warning { color: var(--orange); background: var(--orange-soft); }
.resume-notice { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; margin: 0 0 23px; border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.resume-notice > .icon { color: var(--primary); }
.resume-notice > div { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.resume-notice strong { display: block; font-size: 12px; }
.resume-notice > div > span { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }
.toast { position: fixed; z-index: 120; bottom: 26px; left: 50%; max-width: calc(100% - 32px); padding: 13px 22px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 8px 35px #15213826; font-size: 13px; opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, 12px); pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .2s, transform .2s; }
.toast.visible { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0); }
.modal-backdrop { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 100; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 24px; background: #101b3870; backdrop-filter: blur(4px); }
.modal { width: min(100%, 460px); max-height: calc(100dvh - 48px); overflow-y: auto; padding: 29px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 20px 60px #101b3830; }
.modal h2 { margin-bottom: 13px; font-size: 23px; }
.modal p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; }
.modal-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-top: 25px; }
.image-modal { width: min(100%, 1100px); padding: 20px; }
.image-modal-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.image-modal-header h2 { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: clamp(18px, 3vw, 23px); }
.image-modal-header .icon-button { flex: 0 0 44px; }
.image-modal-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-top: -12px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }
.image-modal-canvas { overflow: auto; max-height: 65dvh; border-radius: 12px; background: #dce8db; overscroll-behavior: contain; }
.image-modal-canvas img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 65dvh; object-fit: contain; }
.image-modal-canvas.is-enlarged img { width: 200%; max-width: none; max-height: none; }
.image-modal .image-description { margin: 13px 0 4px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; }
.image-modal-hint { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }

@keyframes appear { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
@media (min-width: 1450px) {
  .hero-copy { padding: 44px 24px 42px 43px; }
  .hero-art > svg { max-height: 345px; }
}
@media (max-width: 1120px) {
  .header-inner { gap: 16px; padding: 0 28px; }
  .nav-link { padding: 9px 10px; font-size: 12px; }
  .nav-link .icon { display: none; }
  .page-container { width: calc(100% - 56px); }
  .hero-copy { padding: 32px 12px 31px 29px; }
  .hero h1 { font-size: 40px; }
  .hero-art { padding-right: 12px; }
  .stat-card { padding: 19px 15px; column-gap: 10px; }
  .category-card { padding: 19px 16px 16px; }
  .category-card h3 { font-size: 14px; }
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  :root { --header-height: 70px; }
  .header-inner { gap: 14px; padding: 0 24px; }
  .brand-text { font-size: 19px; }
  .brand-icon { width: 35px; height: 35px; border-radius: 10px; }
  .nav-link { padding: 9px 8px; font-size: 11px; }
  .header-actions { gap: 6px; }
  .hero { grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr; }
  .hero h1 { font-size: 35px; letter-spacing: -1.6px; }
  .hero-description { font-size: 13px; }
  .hero-actions .button { padding: 11px 14px; font-size: 12px; }
  .hero-art { padding: 20px 12px 20px 0; }
  .stats-grid { gap: 12px; }
  .stat-card { grid-template-columns: 34px 1fr; padding: 18px 12px; }
  .stat-icon { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px; }
  .stat-icon .icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
  .stat-value { font-size: 22px; }
  .stat-label { font-size: 10px; }
  .category-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .category-description { min-height: 0; }
  .dashboard-bottom { grid-template-columns: 1.3fr 1fr; }
  .setup-layout { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) minmax(230px, 1fr); gap: 18px; }
  .setup-card, .info-card { padding: 23px; }
  .setup-summary { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; }
  .setup-summary:has(> .icon) { flex-direction: row; }
  .progress-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
@media (max-width: 740px) {
  .header-inner { padding: 0 21px; }
  .menu-toggle { display: inline-flex; }
  .main-nav { position: absolute; top: calc(var(--header-height) - 1px); left: 0; right: 0; height: auto; display: none; padding: 13px 21px 19px; background: var(--surface); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: 0 10px 20px #1b2d4510; }
  .main-nav.open { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 7px; }
  .nav-link { min-height: 44px; justify-content: flex-start; padding: 11px 13px; font-size: 13px; }
  .nav-link .icon { display: block; }
  .page-container { width: calc(100% - 42px); padding-top: 24px; }
  .hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .hero-copy { padding: 29px 28px 20px; }
  .hero h1 { max-width: 450px; font-size: 40px; }
  .hero-description { max-width: 460px; }
  .hero-art { padding: 0 20px 18px; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, #eaf0ff 0, #fff 78%); }
  .hero-art > svg { max-height: 210px; width: min(100%, 365px); }
  .art-caption { margin-top: 0; }
  .hero-proof { margin-top: 18px; }
  .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .stat-card { grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr; padding: 20px 17px; gap: 0 13px; }
  .stat-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; }
  .stat-label { font-size: 11px; }
  .dashboard-bottom, .setup-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .daily-card { gap: 12px; }
  .daily-card .button { margin-top: 5px; }
  .section-space { margin-top: 29px; }
  .section-header { gap: 10px; }
  .section-title h2, .section-header h2 { font-size: 20px; }
  .footer-inner { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 13px; padding: 22px 21px; }
  .footer-links { gap: 19px; }
  .setup-summary { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; }
  .quiz-topbar { gap: 12px; }
  .question-card { padding: 24px; }
  .question-text { font-size: 21px; }
  .result-hero { padding: 26px; gap: 22px; }
  .score-ring { width: 118px; height: 118px; }
  .score-number { font-size: 29px; }
  .result-summary h1 { font-size: 24px; }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  h1 { font-size: 29px; }
  .page-container { width: calc(100% - 32px); padding-top: 21px; padding-bottom: 36px; }
  .header-inner { padding: 0 16px; }
  .dashboard-topline { margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .streak-chip { font-size: 10px; padding: 5px 8px; }
  .hero { border-radius: 18px; }
  .hero-copy { padding: 25px 22px 14px; }
  .hero-kicker { margin-bottom: 15px; font-size: 9px; }
  .hero h1 { font-size: 36px; letter-spacing: -1.5px; }
  .hero-description { margin-top: 14px; font-size: 12px; }
  .hero-actions { margin-top: 21px; gap: 9px; }
  .hero-actions .button { flex: 1; padding: 12px 10px; font-size: 11px; }
  .hero-proof { gap: 5px 12px; font-size: 9px; }
  .hero-art > svg { max-height: 180px; }
  .stats-grid { gap: 10px; margin-top: 16px; }
  .stat-card { grid-template-columns: 31px 1fr; gap: 0 10px; padding: 16px 12px; border-radius: 13px; }
  .stat-icon { width: 31px; height: 35px; border-radius: 9px; }
  .stat-value { font-size: 22px; }
  .stat-label { font-size: 10px; }
  .stat-note { font-size: 9px; }
  .category-grid { gap: 11px; }
  .category-card { padding: 16px 13px 13px; border-radius: 13px; }
  .category-top { margin-bottom: 14px; gap: 5px; }
  .category-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 10px; }
  .category-icon .icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
  .category-count { font-size: 9px; }
  .category-card h3 { font-size: 13px; }
  .category-card h3, .category-description { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .category-description { font-size: 10px; min-height: 34px; }
  .category-footer { gap: 7px; padding-top: 11px; margin-top: 14px; }
  .category-percent { font-size: 9px; }
  .category-action { margin-left: 0; }
  .section-title h2, .section-header h2 { font-size: 18px; }
  .section-subtitle { font-size: 11px; }
  .text-button { font-size: 10px; gap: 4px; }
  .text-button .icon { width: 13px; height: 13px; }
  .panel, .daily-card, .setup-card, .info-card, .settings-panel { padding: 21px; border-radius: 16px; }
  .page-description { font-size: 13px; }
  .form-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 19px; }
  .setup-summary { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
  .setup-summary:has(> .icon) { flex-direction: row; }
  .setup-summary .button { width: 100%; }
  .exam-facts { gap: 10px; }
  .exam-facts strong { font-size: 25px; }
  .exam-facts > div > span { font-size: 10px; }
  .empty-state.compact { min-height: 190px; }
  .resume-notice { flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 15px; gap: 10px; }
  .resume-notice > .button { margin-left: 30px; }
  .quiz-title { font-size: 17px; }
  .quiz-meta { font-size: 10px; }
  .timer { min-width: 84px; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 13px; }
  .timer .icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
  .question-card { padding: 20px 17px; border-radius: 16px; }
  .question-heading { gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 17px; }
  .question-text { font-size: 19px; letter-spacing: -.4px; }
  .answer-option { padding: 12px; gap: 11px; font-size: 13px; }
  .answer-letter { width: 28px; height: 28px; }
  .feedback { padding: 15px; font-size: 12px; }
  .quiz-footer { gap: 8px; }
  .quiz-footer .button { padding: 12px 14px; font-size: 11px; }
  .question-nav .button { padding: 10px 11px; min-height: 42px; font-size: 11px; }
  .keyboard-hint { display: none; }
  .result-hero { flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 26px 20px; text-align: center; }
  .result-facts { justify-content: center; gap: 22px; }
  .result-actions { justify-content: center; }
  .result-actions .button { flex: 1; font-size: 11px; padding: 12px; }
  .category-result { grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0, 1fr) 55px; gap: 10px; font-size: 10px; }
  .category-result .category-icon { width: 32px; height: 35px; }
  .category-result > div > strong { font-size: 10px; }
  .review-card { padding: 17px 14px; }
  .review-card summary { grid-template-columns: 25px minmax(0, 1fr) 12px; gap: 10px; font-size: 12px; }
  .review-status { width: 25px; height: 25px; }
  .review-body { padding-left: 0; }
  .filter-bar { gap: 10px; }
  .filter-bar > .field { width: 100%; }
  .search-field, .filter-bar select { width: 100%; min-width: 0; flex-basis: 100%; }
  .library-card { padding: 19px 17px; }
  .library-card h2, .library-card h3 { font-size: 14px; }
  .library-options, .answer-reveal { font-size: 12px; }
  .chart-row { grid-template-columns: 100px minmax(0, 1fr) 30px 30px; gap: 8px; }
  .chart-label { font-size: 10px; }
  .badge-grid { gap: 8px; }
  .achievement { padding: 14px 6px; font-size: 9px; }
  .achievement strong { font-size: 10px; }
  .activity-grid { gap: 4px; }
  .modal-backdrop { padding: 16px; }
  .modal { padding: 24px; }
  .image-modal { padding: 16px; }
  .modal-actions .button { flex: 1; }
}
@media (max-width: 350px) {
  .brand-tag { font-size: 8px; }
  .header-actions { gap: 5px; }
  .icon-button { width: 35px; height: 38px; }
  .hero h1 { font-size: 32px; }
  .hero-actions { flex-direction: column; }
  .stat-card { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 8px; }
  .stat-icon { grid-row: auto; }
  .category-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .category-description { min-height: 0; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
  html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
}
@media print {
  .site-header, .footer, .hero-actions, .question-tools, .quiz-footer, .question-nav, .question-dots, .toast, .modal-backdrop { display: none !important; }
  body { color: #111; background: #fff; font-size: 11pt; }
  .page-container { width: 100%; padding: 0; }
  .panel, .question-card, .result-hero, .review-card, .library-card { break-inside: avoid; box-shadow: none; }
}

/* NuTheorie-video's ----------------------------------------------------- */
.pill.purple:not(.blue):not(.orange):not(.green) { color: #6d50c4; background: var(--purple-soft); }
html[data-theme="dark"] .pill.purple:not(.blue):not(.orange):not(.green) { color: var(--purple); }
.video-stats { margin-bottom: 24px; }
.video-stage { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.75fr) minmax(280px, 1fr); gap: 24px; align-items: start; }
.video-player-card { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.video-frame { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: #0d1424; }
.video-frame video { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: #0d1424; }
.video-frame video:focus-visible { outline-offset: -3px; }
.video-info { padding: 20px 24px 22px; }
.video-info-top { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
.video-info .question-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.video-eyebrow { margin: 16px 0 4px; }
.video-title { font-size: 22px; }
.video-controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-top: 18px; }
.video-controls .button.primary { margin-left: auto; }
.video-speed { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface-soft); }
.video-speed button { min-width: 44px; min-height: 30px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.video-speed button:hover { color: var(--primary); }
.video-speed button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--surface); color: var(--primary); box-shadow: 0 1px 4px #1d2d4e1a; }
.video-message:empty { display: none; }
.video-message { padding: 0 24px 22px; }
.video-notice { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 10px 12px; margin: 0; }
.video-notice > .icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.video-notice > span { flex: 1 1 260px; }
.video-notice code { font-size: 11px; word-break: break-all; }
.video-notice.success { color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); }
.video-notice .text-button { padding: 0; }
.video-queue { position: sticky; top: calc(var(--header-height) + 20px); max-height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height) - 40px); overflow: auto; padding: 22px; }
.video-queue-head h2 { font-size: 18px; }
.video-queue-head .progress-track { margin-top: 12px; }
.video-queue-list { display: grid; gap: 4px; margin: 16px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.video-queue-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 11px; width: 100%; padding: 9px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 11px; background: transparent; color: var(--text); text-align: left; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; transition: background .16s, border-color .16s; }
.video-queue-item:hover { background: var(--surface-soft); }
.video-queue-item.current { border-color: var(--primary); background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--primary); }
.video-queue-num { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface-soft); color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.video-queue-num .icon { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.video-queue-item.watched .video-queue-num { background: var(--green-soft); color: var(--green); }
.video-queue-item.current .video-queue-num { background: #3459e6; color: #fff; }
.video-queue-time { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.video-queue-next { margin-top: 12px; padding-left: 10px; }
.video-chapter-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.video-chapter-nav .choice-button { flex: 0 0 auto; min-height: 38px; padding: 7px 13px; font-size: 12px; }
.video-chapter + .video-chapter { margin-top: 18px; }
.video-chapter-head { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(170px, 230px); align-items: center; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.video-chapter-number { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--primary); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 760; }
.video-chapter-head h3 { font-size: 18px; }
.video-chapter-progress { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-align: right; }
.video-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(170px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
.video-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); text-align: left; transition: border-color .17s, box-shadow .17s, transform .17s; }
.video-card:hover { border-color: #bac8f9; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 25px #253f8010; }
.video-card.current { border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--primary-soft); }
.video-thumb, .video-promo-thumb { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-soft), var(--surface-soft)); }
.video-thumb img, .video-promo-thumb img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.video-play { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; margin: -22px 0 0 -22px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(13, 20, 36, .62); color: #fff; transition: transform .17s, background .17s; }
.video-play .icon { width: 19px; height: 19px; margin-left: 2px; fill: currentColor; }
.video-card:hover .video-play, .video-promo-thumb:hover .video-play { transform: scale(1.08); background: #3459e6; }
.video-duration { position: absolute; right: 8px; bottom: 8px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(13, 20, 36, .8); color: #fff; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.video-badge { position: absolute; left: 8px; top: 8px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 6px; color: #fff; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }
.video-badge .icon { width: 12px; height: 12px; }
.video-badge.watched { background: #18795f; }
.video-badge.current { background: #3459e6; }
.video-badge.current .icon { fill: currentColor; }
.video-card-body { display: grid; gap: 3px; padding: 12px 14px 14px; }
.video-card-label { color: var(--primary); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: 1.2px; text-transform: uppercase; }
.video-card-body strong { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: -.1px; }
.video-card.watched .video-card-body strong { color: var(--muted); }
.video-check .section-header { margin-bottom: 0; }
#video-check-results:not(:empty) { margin-top: 18px; }
.video-check-live { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 192px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 18px; }
.video-check-preview { width: 192px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; border-radius: 10px; background: #0d1424; }
.video-check-status { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.video-check-status strong { color: var(--text); font-size: 13px; }
.video-check-details { margin-top: 14px; }
.video-check-details summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--primary); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; }
.video-check-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin: 14px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.video-check-list li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 26px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px; align-items: start; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface); }
.video-check-list li.fail { border-color: var(--danger); background: var(--danger-soft); }
.video-check-list strong { display: block; font-size: 12px; }
.video-check-list small { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }
.video-check-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); }
.video-check-list li.fail .video-check-icon { color: var(--danger); background: var(--surface); }
.video-check-icon .icon { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.video-footer { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; margin-top: 18px; }
.video-promo { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, 360px) minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 26px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.video-promo-thumb { border-radius: 14px; }
.video-promo-copy { display: grid; gap: 10px; justify-items: start; }
.video-promo-copy .eyebrow { margin: 0; }
.video-promo-copy h2 { font-size: 23px; }
.video-promo-copy p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }
.video-promo-progress { display: grid; gap: 7px; width: min(100%, 360px); color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }
.video-promo-copy .button { margin-top: 4px; }
@media (max-width: 1120px) {
  .video-stage { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.5fr) minmax(250px, 1fr); gap: 18px; }
}
@media (max-width: 980px) {
  /* Met acht menu-items past de navigatie hier niet meer naast het logo: toon het menu achter de knop. */
  .menu-toggle { display: inline-flex; }
  .main-nav { position: absolute; top: calc(var(--header-height) - 1px); left: 0; right: 0; height: auto; display: none; padding: 13px 24px 19px; background: var(--surface); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: 0 10px 20px #1b2d4510; }
  .main-nav.open { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 7px; }
  .nav-link { min-height: 44px; justify-content: flex-start; padding: 11px 13px; font-size: 13px; }
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .video-stage { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .video-queue { position: static; max-height: none; }
  .video-chapter-head { grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .video-chapter-progress { grid-column: 1 / -1; text-align: left; }
}
@media (max-width: 740px) {
  .main-nav { padding: 13px 21px 19px; }
  .video-promo { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 18px; padding: 16px; }
  .video-info { padding: 16px 18px 18px; }
  .video-message { padding: 0 18px 18px; }
  .video-title { font-size: 19px; }
  .video-controls .button { flex: 1 1 auto; }
  .video-controls .button.primary { margin-left: 0; }
  .video-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
  .video-card-body { padding: 10px 11px 12px; }
  .video-check .section-header { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
  .video-check-live { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .video-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .video-chapter-nav .choice-button { flex: 1 1 calc(33% - 8px); padding: 7px 6px; }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Mobiel en touch (audit november 2026): leesbare tekst en vingervriendelijke knoppen.
   Geldt voor schermen tot 740px en voor touchscreens tot 1100px (telefoon liggend, tablet).
   Labels minimaal 11px, lees- en bedieningstekst 12-15px, aanraakdoelen minimaal 44×44px en
   invoervelden 16px, zodat iOS Safari niet automatisch inzoomt. Desktop met muis blijft gelijk.
   ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
@media (max-width: 740px), (pointer: coarse) and (max-width: 1100px) {
  input:not([type="checkbox"]):not([type="radio"]), select, textarea { font-size: 16px; }

  /* Leestekst: antwoorden, uitleg en beschrijvingen */
  .answer-option { font-size: 15px; }
  .feedback { font-size: 14px; }
  .feedback-title { font-size: 15px; }
  .library-options, .answer-reveal, .review-body, .review-card summary, .notice { font-size: 14px; }
  .page-description, .hero-description, .result-summary p, .daily-card > p, .daily-copy p, .empty-state p, .info-row, .source-note { font-size: 14px; }
  .category-description { font-size: 12px; }

  /* Bediening en meta-informatie */
  .button, .hero-actions .button, .quiz-footer .button, .question-nav .button, .result-actions .button { font-size: 13px; }
  .text-button, .source-link, .answer-reveal summary, .video-check-details summary, .section-subtitle, .panel .section-subtitle, .quiz-meta, .list-toolbar, .pagination, .setup-summary, .breadcrumb { font-size: 13px; }
  .checkbox-row > span > strong, .field label, .field > span, .field > legend, .count-fieldset legend, .resume-notice strong, .source-list strong, .dashboard-caption h2 { font-size: 13px; }
  .checkbox-row > span > span, .resume-notice > div > span, .source-list a > span, .question-image figcaption, .question-nav > span, .image-modal-toolbar, .image-modal-hint, .field small, .field-hint { font-size: 12px; }
  .stat-label, .stat-note, .daily-note, .quiz-save-note, .keyboard-hint, .activity-legend, .result-fact, .score-number small, .score-number span, .chart-label, .chart-value, .activity-day, .achievement p, .achievement strong, .recent-copy span, .recent-copy small, .exam-facts > div > span, .streak-chip, .category-percent, .video-queue-time, .video-chapter-progress, .video-promo-progress, .video-check-list small, .footer-inner, .footer-links a, .footer-links button, .dashboard-caption p, .art-caption { font-size: 12px; }
  .category-result, .category-result > div > strong, .category-result > :last-child, .category-result > span:last-child > small, .review-card summary small { font-size: 12px; }

  /* Kleine labels: nooit kleiner dan 11px (het logo-onderschrift 10px) */
  .eyebrow, .question-subcategory, .pill, .hero-kicker, .hero-proof, .category-count, .daily-badge, .chart-label small, .achievement, .achievement > span:last-child, .choice-button > span, .video-card-label, .video-duration, .video-badge { font-size: 11px; }
  .brand-tag { font-size: 10px; }

  /* Aanraakdoelen van minimaal 44×44px */
  .icon-button, .chart-row .icon-button { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
  .favorite-button { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; }
  .brand, .text-button, .source-link, .footer-links a, .footer-links button { min-height: 44px; }
  .footer-links a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }
  .button.small, .question-nav .button, .video-chapter-nav .choice-button, .video-speed button { min-height: 44px; }
  .video-speed button { font-size: 13px; }
  .question-dot { width: 44px; min-height: 44px; font-size: 13px; }
  .answer-reveal summary, .option-explanations > summary, .video-check-details summary { padding-block: 12px; }
  .chart-row { grid-template-columns: 132px minmax(0, 1fr) 36px 44px; }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .chart-row { grid-template-columns: 100px minmax(0, 1fr) 36px 44px; }
}

Je kunt met een schone voortgang verder.' : 'Je browser staat lokale opslag niet toe. Je kunt oefenen, maar je voortgang blijft alleen tijdens dit bezoek bewaard.';

' · de timer loopt door' : ''}</span></div>${button('Verder oefenen', 'resume', '', 'primary small', 'arrow')}</div>`;

'Goed beantwoord' : 'Klaar voor je eerste vraag'}</span><strong>${data.total ? score + '%' : '—'}</strong></div>${progressBar(score, `Percentage correct: ${c.label}`)}<button class="category-action" data-action="category" data-category="${i}">Oefenen ${icon('arrow')}</button></div></article>`;
    }).join('')}</div></section><section class="dashboard-bottom section-space"><div class="panel"><div class="section-header"><div class="section-title"><h2>Je laatste sessies</h2><p class="section-subtitle">Kleine stappen, zichtbare vooruitgang.</p></div><a class="text-button" href="#progress">Voortgang ${icon('arrow')}</a></div>${recentResults(3)}</div><div class="daily-card"><span class="daily-badge">JOUW DAGELIJKSE MOMENT</span><span class="daily-icon">${icon('spark')}</span><h2>10 vragen.<br>Een stap dichterbij.</h2><p>Een beetje oefenen, elke dag.
