  if (type==='sun') return h.circle(620,65,88,'#fff5bf','opacity=".4"')+h.circle(620,65,45,'#fff4b2','opacity=".7"')+[[-90,130],[-40,180],[30,190]].map(([a,b])=>h.line(620,90,620+a,90+b,'#fff5c8',17,'opacity=".3"')).join('');
  if (type==='wind') return [100,160,220].map(y=>h.path(`M40 ${y}q50 -30 120 0t110 0`,'none','#f2f6ef',4,'opacity=".8"')).join('');
  return '';
};

function generate() {
  const signs = require('./illustrations/signs.cjs');
  h.sign = (code,x,y,size=64) => {
    if (!signs.symbols[code]) throw new Error(`Onbekend verkeersbord: ${code}`);
    return h.line(x,y,x,y+size*.85,'#7e8a96',5)+`<g transform="translate(${x-size/2} ${y-size/2}) scale(${size/120})">${signs.symbols[code]}</g>`;
  };
  const records = [...require('./illustrations/roads.cjs')(h), ...signs.questions(h), ...require('./illustrations/hazards.cjs')(h)].sort((a,b)=>a.id-b.id);
  const context={window:{}};
  vm.runInNewContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT,'questions.js'),'utf8'),context);
  const questions=context.window.THEORY_QUESTIONS;
  const byId=new Map(questions.map(q=>[q.id,q]));
  const seen=new Set();
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(ROOT,'images','signs'),{recursive:true});
  const wrap=(svg,title,w=800,ht=500)=>`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${ht}" width="${w}" height="${ht}" role="img"><title>${esc(title)}</title>${svg}</svg>\n`;
  for (const q of questions) { q.image=null; q.imageAlt=''; }
  for (const item of records) {
    if (seen.has(item.id) || !byId.has(item.id) || !item.alt || !item.svg) throw new Error(`Ongeldig illustratierecord ${item.id}`);
    seen.add(item.id);
    const q=byId.get(item.id);
    q.image=`images/question-${String(q.id).padStart(3,'0')}.svg`;
    q.imageAlt=item.alt;
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(ROOT,q.image),wrap(item.svg,item.alt));
  }
  for (const [code,svg] of Object.entries(signs.symbols)) {
    const filename=signs.files[code];
    if (!filename || !/^[a-z0-9-]+\.svg$/.test(filename)) throw new Error(`Onjuist bordbestand ${code}`);
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(ROOT,'images','signs',filename),wrap(svg,`Zelfgetekend verkeersbord ${code}`,120,120));
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(ROOT,'questions.js'),'/* Zelfgeschreven oefenvragen voor Rijbewijs B. Afbeeldingen: eigen lokale SVG-illustraties. */\nwindow.THEORY_QUESTIONS = '+JSON.stringify(questions,null,2)+';\n');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(ROOT,'illustrations','manifest.json'),JSON.stringify(records.map(r=>({id:r.id,image:byId.get(r.id).image,alt:r.alt,note:r.note||''})),null,2)+'\n');
  const gallery=records.map(r=>({id:r.id,image:'../'+byId.get(r.id).image,alt:r.alt,question:byId.get(r.id).question}));
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(ROOT,'illustrations','overzicht.html'),`<!doctype html><html lang="nl"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Eigen verkeersillustraties — overzicht</title><style>*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;padding:20px;font:14px Arial,sans-serif;background:#f3f5f8;color:#25334b}header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;max-width:1400px;margin:auto auto 18px}h1{font-size:22px;margin:0}nav{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center}button{padding:12px;background:white;border:1px solid #ccd4de;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;max-width:1400px;margin:auto}figure{background:white;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;margin:0;border:1px solid #dce2e9}img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}figcaption{padding:9px 12px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.4;min-height:65px}strong{color:#3459e6}a{color:inherit}@media(max-width:800px){main{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}header{flex-direction:column}}</style><header><h1>${records.length} eigen verkeersillustraties</h1><nav><button id="prev">Vorige</button><span id="page"></span><button id="next">Volgende</button><a href="../index.html">Naar de trainer</a></nav></header><main id="grid"></main><script>const items=${JSON.stringify(gallery).replace(/</g,'\\u003c')};let page=0;const escape=s=>s.replace(/[&<>\"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));function render(){document.getElementById('grid').innerHTML=items.slice(page*12,page*12+12).map(q=>'<figure><img width="800" height="500" src="'+q.image+'" alt="'+escape(q.alt)+'"><figcaption><strong>Vraag '+q.id+'</strong> '+escape(q.question)+'</figcaption></figure>').join('');document.getElementById('page').textContent=(page+1)+' / '+Math.ceil(items.length/12);document.getElementById('prev').disabled=page===0;document.getElementById('next').disabled=(page+1)*12>=items.length}document.getElementById('prev').onclick=()=>{page--;render()};document.getElementById('next').onclick=()=>{page++;render()};render();</script></html>`);
  console.log(`${records.length} vraagillustraties en ${Object.keys(signs.symbols).length} verkeersborden gegenereerd.`);
}
if (require.main === module) generate();
module.exports = { h, generate };

## tools/code-bundle.py

```
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Schrijft docs/VOLLEDIGE-CODE.md: alle tekstbestanden van het project in één leesbaar Markdown-bestand.

Gebruik, vanuit de projectmap:  python3 tools/code-bundle.py

Het bundelbestand is een momentopname om te lezen of te delen; de losse bestanden blijven de
bewerkbare versie. Foto's, video's, het archief en de losse oefentoets (met ingebedde
afbeeldingen) worden niet opgenomen. Alleen standaard-Python; geen extra pakketten nodig.
"""
import os
import re

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
OUT = os.path.join('docs', 'VOLLEDIGE-CODE.md')
FIRST = ['index.html', 'style.css', 'script.js', 'questions.js', 'questions-extra.js', 'questions-nutheorie.js', 'videos.js',
         'README.md', 'package.json', '.gitignore', '.gitattributes', 'traffic-images.js']
FOLDERS = ['tools', 'tests', 'illustrations', 'images']
TEXT = re.compile(r'\.(html|css|js|cjs|mjs|json|md|py|svg|txt)$', re.I)


def files():
    seen = []
    for name in FIRST:
        if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(ROOT, name)):
            seen.append(name)
    for folder in FOLDERS:
        for base, dirs, names in os.walk(os.path.join(ROOT, folder)):
            dirs[:] = sorted(d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.'))
            for name in sorted(names):
                rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(base, name), ROOT).replace(os.sep, '/')
                if TEXT.search(name) and not name.startswith('.') and rel not in seen:
                    seen.append(rel)
    return seen


def main():
    parts = ['# TheorieTrainer — volledige broncode\n',
             'Automatisch samengestelde momentopname van de projectbestanden, gemaakt met `python3 tools/code-bundle.py`. '
             'De losse bronbestanden in de map blijven de bewerkbare projectversie. Niet opgenomen: foto\'s (JPG/PNG), '
             'de video\'s in `Nutheorie_Videos/`, `extra/auto-theorie-oefentoets.html` (bevat ingebedde afbeeldingen) en de mappen '
             '`_archief/` en `dist/`.\n']
    listed = files()
    for rel in listed:
        with open(os.path.join(ROOT, rel), encoding='utf-8') as handle:
            content = handle.read()
        longest = max((len(m) for m in re.findall(r'`{3,}', content)), default=0)
        fence = '`' * max(3, longest + 1)
        parts.append(f'## {rel}\n\n{fence}\n{content.rstrip()}\n{fence}\n')
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(ROOT, 'docs'), exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(ROOT, OUT), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
        handle.write('\n'.join(parts))
    size = os.path.getsize(os.path.join(ROOT, OUT))
    print(f'{OUT} geschreven: {len(listed)} bestanden, {size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

## tools/server.cjs

```
#!/usr/bin/env node
/* Kleine webserver om TheorieTrainer via http te openen, bijvoorbeeld op je telefoon.
 *
 *   node tools/server.cjs            alleen op deze computer: http://localhost:8080
 *   node tools/server.cjs --lan      ook voor andere apparaten op hetzelfde wifi-netwerk
 *   node tools/server.cjs --port 9000
 *
 * Geen extra pakketten nodig. Ondersteunt 'Range'-verzoeken: zonder die ondersteuning spelen
 * video's op een iPhone (Safari) niet af en werkt doorspoelen niet goed.
 * Stoppen: Ctrl+C. Op de computer zelf kun je index.html ook gewoon dubbelklikken.
 */
'use strict';
const http = require('node:http');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const lan = args.includes('--lan');
const portArg = args.indexOf('--port');
const port = Number(portArg >= 0 ? args[portArg + 1] : process.env.PORT || 8080);
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const types = {
  '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', '.js': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8', '.cjs': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8',
  '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8', '.json': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', '.md': 'text/markdown; charset=utf-8',
  '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.png': 'image/png', '.jpg': 'image/jpeg', '.jpeg': 'image/jpeg', '.webp': 'image/webp',
  '.mp4': 'video/mp4', '.m4v': 'video/mp4', '.webm': 'video/webm'
};

function send(res, status, headers, body) {
  res.writeHead(status, { 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff', ...headers });
  res.end(body);
}

const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') return send(res, 405, { Allow: 'GET, HEAD' }, 'Methode niet toegestaan');
  let rel;
  try { rel = decodeURIComponent(new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost').pathname); } catch { return send(res, 400, {}, 'Ongeldig adres'); }
  if (rel.endsWith('/')) rel += 'index.html';
  const file = path.resolve(root, '.' + rel);
  // Alleen bestanden binnen de projectmap, geen verborgen bestanden of mappen (zoals .git).
  if (file !== root && !file.startsWith(root + path.sep)) return send(res, 403, {}, 'Geen toegang');
  if (path.relative(root, file).split(path.sep).some(part => part.startsWith('.'))) return send(res, 404, {}, 'Niet gevonden');
  fs.stat(file, (error, stat) => {
    if (error || !stat.isFile()) return send(res, 404, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' }, 'Niet gevonden');
    const type = types[path.extname(file).toLowerCase()] || 'application/octet-stream';
    const range = /^bytes=(\d*)-(\d*)$/.exec(req.headers.range || '');
    let start = 0, end = stat.size - 1, status = 200;
    const headers = { 'Content-Type': type, 'Accept-Ranges': 'bytes', 'Last-Modified': stat.mtime.toUTCString() };
    if (range && (range[1] !== '' || range[2] !== '')) {
      if (range[1] === '') { start = Math.max(0, stat.size - Number(range[2])); }
      else { start = Number(range[1]); if (range[2] !== '') end = Math.min(Number(range[2]), stat.size - 1); }
      if (start > end || start >= stat.size) return send(res, 416, { 'Content-Range': `bytes */${stat.size}` }, '');
      status = 206;
      headers['Content-Range'] = `bytes ${start}-${end}/${stat.size}`;
    }
    headers['Content-Length'] = end - start + 1;
    res.writeHead(status, { 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff', ...headers });
    if (req.method === 'HEAD' || stat.size === 0) return res.end();
    const stream = fs.createReadStream(file, { start, end });
    stream.on('error', () => res.destroy());
    res.on('close', () => stream.destroy());
    stream.pipe(res);
  });
});

server.on('error', error => {
  console.error(error.code === 'EADDRINUSE' ? `Poort ${port} is al in gebruik. Kies een andere, bijvoorbeeld: node tools/server.cjs --port 8081` : error.message);
  process.exit(1);
});

server.listen(port, lan ? '0.0.0.0' : '127.0.0.1', () => {
  console.log(`TheorieTrainer draait op http://localhost:${port}/`);
  if (lan) {
    const addresses = Object.values(os.networkInterfaces()).flat().filter(a => a && a.family === 'IPv4' && !a.internal).map(a => a.address);
    for (const address of addresses) console.log(`Op je telefoon (zelfde wifi): http://${address}:${port}/`);
    console.log('Let op: zolang de server draait, kan iedereen op dit netwerk de website openen.');
  } else {
    console.log('Alleen op deze computer bereikbaar. Gebruik --lan om hem op je telefoon te openen.');
  }
  console.log('Stoppen: Ctrl+C');
});
```

## tools/videos-manifest.py

```
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bouwt videos.js: de lijst met NuTheorie-video's voor de pagina 'Video's'.

Gebruik, vanuit de projectmap:  python3 tools/videos-manifest.py

- Leest de map Nutheorie_Videos/HoofdstukN/NN_Titel.mp4 (.m4v en .webm mogen ook).
- Sorteert op hoofdstuknummer en daarna op lesnummer (numeriek, dus 2 vóór 10).
- Legt de speelduur vast als ffprobe beschikbaar is (anders toont de site '—').
- Gebruikt een voorbeeldplaatje images/videos/hN-NN.jpg als dat bestaat. Ontbreekt het
  plaatje en is ffmpeg beschikbaar, dan wordt het automatisch gemaakt.
Alleen standaard-Python; geen extra pakketten nodig.
"""
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
FOLDER = 'Nutheorie_Videos'
POSTERS = os.path.join('images', 'videos')
CHAPTER_RE = re.compile(r'^hoofdstuk\s*_?(\d+)$', re.I)
VIDEO_RE = re.compile(r'^(\d+)[ _-]+(.+)\.(mp4|m4v|webm)$', re.I)

# Nettere titels dan de bestandsnaam alleen kan geven (sleutel = bestandsnaam zonder nummer en extensie).
TITLES = {
    'Risicos_ivm_aanwezigheid_en_gedrag_verkeer': "Risico's i.v.m. aanwezigheid en gedrag verkeer",
    'Stop_en_volgafstand': 'Stop- en volgafstand',
    'Weg_zicht_en_weersomstandigheden': 'Weg, zicht en weersomstandigheden',
    'Uitrit_onverharde_weg_of_wegversmalling': 'Uitrit, onverharde weg of wegversmalling',
    'Tram_militaire_colonne_rouwstoet': 'Tram, militaire colonne en rouwstoet',
}


def nice_title(stem):
    if stem in TITLES:
        return TITLES[stem]
    title = re.sub(r'[_]+', ' ', stem).strip()
    title = re.sub(r'\bSamenvatting Hoofdstuk\b', 'Samenvatting hoofdstuk', title)
    return title[:1].upper() + title[1:]


def duration_of(path):
    if not shutil.which('ffprobe'):
        return None
    result = subprocess.run(['ffprobe', '-v', 'error', '-show_entries', 'format=duration', '-of', 'csv=p=0', path],
                            capture_output=True, text=True)
    try:
        return round(float(result.stdout.strip()), 2)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def poster_for(video_path, poster_rel, duration):
    poster_abs = os.path.join(ROOT, poster_rel)
    if os.path.exists(poster_abs):
        return poster_rel.replace(os.sep, '/')
    if not shutil.which('ffmpeg'):
        return None
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(poster_abs), exist_ok=True)
    moment = min(max((duration or 60) * 0.15, 8), max((duration or 60) - 5, 0))
    subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-v', 'error', '-y', '-ss', f'{moment:.2f}', '-i', video_path, '-frames:v', '1',
                    '-vf', 'scale=640:360', '-q:v', '4', poster_abs], check=False)
    return poster_rel.replace(os.sep, '/') if os.path.exists(poster_abs) else None


def main():
    base = os.path.join(ROOT, FOLDER)
    if not os.path.isdir(base):
        sys.exit(f'Map niet gevonden: {base}')
    chapters, skipped = [], []
    for entry in os.listdir(base):
        match = CHAPTER_RE.match(entry)
        if not match or not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(base, entry)):
            if not entry.startswith('.'):
                skipped.append(entry)
            continue
        number = int(match.group(1))
        videos = []
        for name in os.listdir(os.path.join(base, entry)):
            video_match = VIDEO_RE.match(name)
            if not video_match:
                if not name.startswith('.'):
                    skipped.append(f'{entry}/{name}')
                continue
            lesson = int(video_match.group(1))
            stem = video_match.group(2)
            rel = f'{FOLDER}/{entry}/{name}'
            duration = duration_of(os.path.join(base, entry, name))
            video_id = f'h{number}-{lesson:02d}'
            videos.append({
                'id': video_id,
                'number': lesson,
                'title': nice_title(stem),
                'file': rel,
                'duration': duration,
                'poster': poster_for(os.path.join(base, entry, name), os.path.join(POSTERS, f'{video_id}.jpg'), duration),
                'summary': stem.lower().startswith('samenvatting'),
            })
        videos.sort(key=lambda v: (v['number'], v['file']))
        ids = [v['id'] for v in videos]
        if len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
            sys.exit(f'{entry}: twee video\'s hebben hetzelfde lesnummer. Hernoem er één.')
        if videos:
            chapters.append({'number': number, 'title': f'Hoofdstuk {number}', 'videos': videos})
    chapters.sort(key=lambda c: c['number'])
    if len({c['number'] for c in chapters}) != len(chapters):
        sys.exit('Twee mappen hebben hetzelfde hoofdstuknummer.')
    data = {'folder': FOLDER, 'chapters': chapters}
    out = ('/* NuTheorie-videolessen, op volgorde van hoofdstuk en les.\n'
           '   Gegenereerd met: python3 tools/videos-manifest.py — niet handmatig bewerken. */\n'
           'window.NUTHEORIE_VIDEOS = ' + json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + ';\n')
    with open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'videos.js'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
        handle.write(out)
    total = sum(len(c['videos']) for c in chapters)
    print(f'videos.js geschreven: {total} video\'s in {len(chapters)} hoofdstukken.')
    for c in chapters:
        print(f"  Hoofdstuk {c['number']}: " + ', '.join(f"{v['number']}. {v['title']}" for v in c['videos']))
    if skipped:
        print('Overgeslagen (geen hoofdstukmap of geen ondersteund videobestand): ' + ', '.join(sorted(skipped)))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

'use strict';
// Structural checks, deterministic regeneration and optional HTTP asset check.
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const vm = require('node:vm');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const crypto = require('node:crypto');
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const ctx = { window: {} };
vm.runInNewContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'questions.js'), 'utf8'), ctx);
vm.runInNewContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'questions-extra.js'), 'utf8'), ctx);
const qs = [...ctx.window.THEORY_QUESTIONS, ...ctx.window.THEORY_QUESTIONS_EXTRA];
const pictures = qs.filter(q => q.image);
assert(pictures.length >= 80, `Only ${pictures.length} illustrated questions`);
const fingerprints = new Set();
const paths = new Set();
let total = 0;
for (const q of qs) {
  assert(Object.hasOwn(q, 'image'), `Missing image field: ${q.id}`);
  if (!q.image) { assert.equal(q.image, null); continue; }
  assert.equal(q.image, `images/question-${String(q.id).padStart(3, '0')}.svg`);
  assert(q.imageAlt.length >= 30, `Short alt: ${q.id}`);
  assert(!/(heeft voorrang|moet wachten|juiste antwoord|mag als eerste|correcte antwoord)/i.test(q.imageAlt), `Answer in alt ${q.id}`);
  assert(!paths.has(q.image), `Reused file ${q.image}`);
  paths.add(q.image);
  const svg = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, q.image), 'utf8');
  assert(svg.startsWith('<svg '));
  assert(svg.includes('viewBox="0 0 800 500"'));
  assert(!/<(?:script|foreignObject|image|iframe)\b/i.test(svg), `Non-vector content in ${q.image}`);
  assert(!/\b(?:href|src)\s*=|@import|\b(?:NaN|undefined)\b/i.test(svg), `Broken or external reference in ${q.image}`);
  for (const reference of svg.matchAll(/url\s*\(([^)]*)\)/gi)) {
    const target = reference[1].trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');
    assert(/^#[\w-]+$/.test(target), `External SVG paint in ${q.image}`);
    assert(svg.includes(`id="${target.slice(1)}"`), `Missing SVG paint definition in ${q.image}`);
  }
  assert(!/\son[a-z]+\s*=/i.test(svg));
  const drawing = svg.replace(/<title>.*?<\/title>/s, '');
  const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(drawing).digest('hex');
  assert(!fingerprints.has(hash), `Identical drawing ${q.id}`);
  fingerprints.add(hash);
  assert(Buffer.byteLength(svg) < 80000, `Unnecessarily large asset ${q.id}`);
  total += Buffer.byteLength(svg);
}
const signFiles = fs.readdirSync(path.join(root, 'images', 'signs')).filter(x => x.endsWith('.svg'));
assert(signFiles.length >= 15);
for (const file of signFiles) {
  const svg = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'images', 'signs', file), 'utf8');
  assert(svg.includes('viewBox="0 0 120 120"'));
  assert(!/<(?:script|image|foreignObject)\b|\b(?:href|src)\s*=/i.test(svg));
}
assert(total < 3 * 1024 * 1024, 'Illustrations must remain lightweight');
const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'illustrations', 'manifest.json')));
assert.equal(manifest.length, pictures.length);
assert(manifest.every(r => r.note && r.alt && paths.has(r.image)), 'Every illustration needs a question-match review note');
console.log(`PASS ${pictures.length} unique local question illustrations; ${signFiles.length} signs; ${(total / 1024).toFixed(0)} KiB question SVGs.`);

const base = process.argv[2];
if (base) (async () => {
  const urls = ['index.html','script.js','style.css','questions.js','questions-extra.js', ...paths, ...signFiles.map(f=>'images/signs/'+f)];
  for (let offset=0; offset<urls.length; offset+=8) {
    await Promise.all(urls.slice(offset,offset+8).map(async file => {
      const response = await fetch(new URL(file, base));
      assert.equal(response.status, 200, `${file} HTTP failure`);
      const bytes = await response.arrayBuffer();
      assert.equal(bytes.byteLength, fs.statSync(path.join(root, file)).size, `${file} incomplete response`);
    }));
  }
  console.log(`PASS ${urls.length} local HTTP resources; no 404s or incomplete files.`);
})().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode=1; });

```
'use strict';

// Run from the project directory: node tests/validate.cjs
// Uses only Node built-ins. Browser interaction is tested separately.
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const vm = require('node:vm');
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const questionContext = { window: {} };
vm.runInNewContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'questions.js'), 'utf8'), questionContext);
vm.runInNewContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'questions-extra.js'), 'utf8'), questionContext);
vm.runInNewContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'questions-nutheorie.js'), 'utf8'), questionContext);
vm.runInNewContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'videos.js'), 'utf8'), questionContext);
const videoData = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(questionContext.window.NUTHEORIE_VIDEOS));
const baseQuestions = questionContext.window.THEORY_QUESTIONS;
const extraQuestions = questionContext.window.THEORY_QUESTIONS_EXTRA;
const nutheorieQuestions = questionContext.window.THEORY_QUESTIONS_NUTHEORIE;
const trainerQuestions = [...baseQuestions, ...extraQuestions];
const questions = [...trainerQuestions, ...nutheorieQuestions];
const appSource = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'script.js'), 'utf8');
const plain = value => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
let passed = 0;
function test(name, fn) {
  fn();
  passed++;
  console.log(`PASS ${name}`);
}

const exportCode = `  window.__test = {
  shuffleArray, seededRandom, blankProgress, validateSession, loadProgress, saveProgress,
  getPracticePool, startPractice, startExam, startDaily, createSession, calculateResults, submitAnswer, learningDetails,
  finishQuiz, tickTimer, toggleFavorite, resetProgress, closeConfirm, showImage, questionImage, hasLocalImage,
  renderVideos, videoLibrary, loadVideoStore, get videoStore() { return videoStore; },
  get imageDialogOpen() { return imageDialogOpen; },
  get confirmCallback() { return confirmCallback; },
  get state() { return state; }, set state(value) { state = value; },
  get setup() { return setup; }, set setup(value) { setup = value; },
  get lastResult() { return lastResult; },
  get storageAvailable() { return storageAvailable; }
};`;
assert.equal((appSource.match(/^  initApp\(\);$/gm) || []).length, 1, 'Test injection must replace exactly one init call');
const testSource = appSource.replace(/^  initApp\(\);$/m, exportCode);

function environment({ raw = null, denied = false } = {}) {
  let now = new Date('2026-10-15T12:00:00Z').getTime();
  let saved = raw;
  let writes = 0;
  class FakeDate extends Date {
    constructor(...args) { super(...(args.length ? args : [now])); }
    static now() { return now; }
  }
  const elements = new Map();
  const element = selector => {
    if (!elements.has(selector)) elements.set(selector, {
      innerHTML: '', textContent: '', dataset: {}, style: {}, isConnected: true,
      classList: { add() {}, remove() {}, toggle() {} },
      parentElement: { classList: { toggle() {} } },
      focus() {}, setAttribute() {}, removeAttribute() {}, scrollIntoView() {},
      querySelectorAll() { return []; }
    });
    return elements.get(selector);
  };
  const location = { hash: '#dashboard' };
  const context = {
    Date: FakeDate, console,
    window: { THEORY_QUESTIONS: baseQuestions, THEORY_QUESTIONS_EXTRA: extraQuestions, THEORY_QUESTIONS_NUTHEORIE: nutheorieQuestions, NUTHEORIE_VIDEOS: videoData, scrollTo() {} },
    document: {
      querySelector: element, querySelectorAll: () => [],
      body: element('body'), documentElement: element('html'), activeElement: null
    },
    location,
    localStorage: {
      getItem() { if (denied) throw new Error('Access denied'); return saved; },
      setItem(_key, value) { if (denied) throw new Error('Access denied'); writes++; saved = value; }
    },
    setInterval: () => 1, clearInterval() {}, setTimeout: () => 1, clearTimeout() {}
  };
  vm.runInNewContext(testSource, context, { filename: 'script.js' });
  return {
    api: context.window.__test, location, element,
    advance(ms) { now += ms; },
    get saved() { return saved; }, get writes() { return writes; }
  };
}

test('question schema: 220 existing questions plus 300 unique, complete additions', () => {
  assert.equal(baseQuestions.length, 220);
  assert.equal(extraQuestions.length, 300);
  assert.equal(trainerQuestions.length, 520);
  assert.equal(new Set(trainerQuestions.map(q => q.id)).size, trainerQuestions.length);
  assert.equal(new Set(trainerQuestions.map(q => q.question)).size, trainerQuestions.length);
  const expected = {
    'Verkeersregels': 145, 'Verkeersborden en wegmarkeringen': 80,
    'Gevaarherkenning en verkeersinzicht': 65, 'Veilig rijden': 80,
    'Bijzondere verkeersdeelnemers': 40, 'Voertuigkennis': 39,
    'Milieu en verantwoord rijgedrag': 25, 'Bestuurder, wetgeving en documenten': 46
  };
  const counts = {};
  for (const [index, q] of trainerQuestions.entries()) {
    assert.equal(q.id, index + 1);
    for (const field of ['category', 'subcategory', 'question', 'explanation', 'difficulty', 'type', 'source']) {
      assert.ok(typeof q[field] === 'string' && q[field].trim(), `${q.id}: missing ${field}`);
    }
    assert.ok(q.options.length >= 3 && q.options.length <= 4, `${q.id}: must have 3–4 options`);
    assert.equal(new Set(q.options).size, q.options.length, `${q.id}: duplicate option`);
    assert.ok(q.options.every(value => typeof value === 'string' && value.trim()));
    assert.ok(Number.isInteger(q.correctAnswer) && q.correctAnswer >= 0 && q.correctAnswer < q.options.length);
    assert.ok(['makkelijk', 'gemiddeld', 'moeilijk'].includes(q.difficulty));
    assert.match(q.source, /^https:\/\//);
    counts[q.category] = (counts[q.category] || 0) + 1;
  }
  assert.deepEqual(counts, expected);
  const topics = {
    'Verkeersborden, onderborden en verkeerstekens': 30,
    'Voorrang, kruispunten en voorrangsregels': 30,
    'Snelheid, maximumsnelheden en aangepaste snelheid': 20,
    'Inhalen, invoegen, uitvoegen en rijstrookwisselingen': 20,
    'Plaats op de weg, voorsorteren en bijzondere manoeuvres': 20,
    'Parkeren, stilstaan en parkeerverboden': 15,
    'Verkeerslichten, aanwijzingen en verkeersregelaars': 15,
    'Gevaarherkenning en defensief rijden': 25,
    'Kwetsbare verkeersdeelnemers, fietsers en voetgangers': 20,
    'Snelwegen, autowegen, tunnels en spitsstroken': 15,
    'Weersomstandigheden, zicht, gladheid en remweg': 15,
    'Alcohol, drugs, medicijnen, vermoeidheid en afleiding': 15,
    'Voertuigkennis, banden, verlichting en onderhoud': 15,
    'Veiligheid, gordels, kinderzitjes en lading': 10,
    'Milieu, zuinig rijden en milieubewust verkeersgedrag': 10,
    'Ongevallen, pech, hulpverlening en noodsituaties': 10,
    'Wettelijke regels, documenten en voertuigverplichtingen': 5,
    'Gemengde examencasussen en complexe verkeerssituaties': 10
  };
  assert.deepEqual(Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(topics).map(topic => [topic, extraQuestions.filter(q => q.subcategory === topic).length])), topics);
  assert.deepEqual(Object.fromEntries(['makkelijk', 'gemiddeld', 'moeilijk'].map(level => [level, extraQuestions.filter(q => q.difficulty === level).length])), { makkelijk: 90, gemiddeld: 120, moeilijk: 90 });
  for (const q of extraQuestions) {
    assert.equal(q.id, 221 + extraQuestions.indexOf(q), `unstable supplemental id ${q.id}`);
    assert.equal(q.options.length, 3);
    assert.equal(q.optionExplanations.length, q.options.length);
    assert.ok(q.focusDetail && q.misconception && q.tags.length >= 2);
  }
});

  for (const c of chapters) {
    assert.deepEqual(c.videos.map(v => v.number), c.videos.map((_, i) => i + 1), `hoofdstuk ${c.number}: lessen niet op volgorde`);
    for (const v of c.videos) {

      assert.ok(v.title.trim() && !v.title.includes('_'), `${v.id}: titel`);

  if (fs.existsSync(folder)) {
    for (const v of all) {
      const file = path.join(root, v.file);
      assert.ok(fs.existsSync(file), `${v.file} ontbreekt`);
      const lfsPointer = fs.statSync(file).size < 1024 && fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8').startsWith('version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/');
      assert.ok(!lfsPointer, `${v.file} is nog een Git LFS-verwijzing: voer 'git lfs pull' uit (zie README)`);
      assert.ok(fs.statSync(file).size > 1000000, `${v.file} is leeg of onvolledig`);
    }
    const onDisk = fs.readdirSync(folder).filter(d => /^Hoofdstuk\d+$/.test(d))
      .flatMap(d => fs.readdirSync(path.join(folder, d)).filter(f => /\.(mp4|m4v|webm)$/i.test(f)).map(f => `Nutheorie_Videos/${d}/${f}`));
    assert.deepEqual([...onDisk].sort(), all.map(v => v.file).sort(), 'elke video in de map staat op de pagina en andersom');
  } else console.log("  (map Nutheorie_Videos niet gevonden: bestandscontrole overgeslagen)");
});

});

test('instinker and image-only practice filters return only matching questions', () => {
  const { api } = environment();
  api.setup = { category: 'all', count: 10, difficulty: 'all', smart: false, instinker: true, imageOnly: false };
  const traps = api.getPracticePool();
  assert.ok(traps.length >= 90);
  assert.ok(traps.every(q => q.type === 'instinker' || q.tags?.includes('instinker')));
  api.setup = { category: 'all', count: 10, difficulty: 'all', smart: false, instinker: false, imageOnly: true };
  const illustrated = api.getPracticePool();
  assert.equal(trainerQuestions.filter(q => q.image).length, 217);
  assert.equal(illustrated.length, questions.filter(q => q.image).length);
  assert.ok(illustrated.every(q => q.image));
});

test('exam presents 52 unique questions across all nine categories; only 50 are scored', () => {
  const { api } = environment();
  api.startExam();
  const session = api.state.active;
  assert.equal(session.items.length, 52);
  assert.equal(session.items.filter(item => !item.unscored).length, 50);
  assert.equal(session.items.filter(item => item.unscored).length, 2);
  assert.equal(new Set(session.items.map(item => item.id)).size, 52);
  assert.equal(new Set(session.items.filter(item => !item.unscored).map(item => questions.find(q => q.id === item.id).category)).size, 9);
  assert.equal(session.deadline - session.startedAt, 30 * 60 * 1000);
  for (const item of session.items) {
    const q = questions.find(q => q.id === item.id);
    assert.deepEqual([...item.order].sort(), [...q.options].map((_, i) => i));
  }
});

test('shuffled display order maps to original answer indices', () => {
  const { api } = environment();
  const q = questions[0];
  const order = [2, 0, 1];
  const displayedCorrect = order.indexOf(q.correctAnswer);
  const session = { items: [{ id: q.id, order }], answers: { [q.id]: order[displayedCorrect] } };
  assert.equal(api.calculateResults(session).correct, 1);
  session.answers[q.id] = (q.correctAnswer + 1) % q.options.length;
  assert.equal(api.calculateResults(session).correct, 0);
  delete session.answers[q.id];
  assert.equal(api.calculateResults(session).unanswered, 1);
});

test('practice counts an answer once and persists a resumable answer/order', () => {
  const env = environment();
  const q = questions[0];
  env.api.createSession([q], 'practice', 'Single question');
  env.api.submitAnswer(q.correctAnswer);
  env.api.submitAnswer((q.correctAnswer + 1) % q.options.length);
  assert.equal(env.api.state.total, 1);
  assert.equal(env.api.state.correct, 1);
  const resumed = environment({ raw: env.saved });
  assert.equal(resumed.api.state.total, 1);
  assert.equal(resumed.api.state.active.answers[q.id], q.correctAnswer);
  assert.deepEqual(plain(resumed.api.state.active.items), plain(env.api.state.active.items));
  resumed.api.submitAnswer(q.correctAnswer);
  assert.equal(resumed.api.state.total, 1);
});

test('a wrong answer is removed from the review list after a correct retry', () => {
  const env = environment();
  const q = questions[0];
  env.api.createSession([q], 'practice', 'Wrong');
  env.api.submitAnswer((q.correctAnswer + 1) % q.options.length);
  assert.ok(env.api.state.wrongIds.includes(q.id));
  env.location.hash = '#dashboard';
  env.api.createSession([q], 'wrong', 'Retry');
  env.api.submitAnswer(q.correctAnswer);
  assert.equal(env.api.state.wrongIds.includes(q.id), false);
  assert.equal(env.api.state.total, 2);
  assert.equal(env.api.state.correct, 1);
});

test('exam answers are counted only on finish, using the final answer', () => {
  const { api } = environment();
  api.startExam();
  const scoredItem = api.state.active.items.find(item => !item.unscored);
  api.state.active.position = api.state.active.items.findIndex(item => item.id === scoredItem.id);
  const q = questions.find(q => q.id === scoredItem.id);
  api.submitAnswer((q.correctAnswer + 1) % q.options.length);
  api.submitAnswer(q.correctAnswer);
  assert.equal(api.state.total, 0);
  assert.equal(api.state.examCount, 0);
  api.finishQuiz();
  assert.equal(api.state.total, 1);
  assert.equal(api.state.correct, 1);
  assert.equal(api.state.examCount, 1);
  assert.equal(api.lastResult.correct, 1);
  assert.equal(api.lastResult.unanswered, 49);
  assert.equal(api.state.wrongIds.length, 49);
  assert.equal(api.lastResult.total, 50);
  api.finishQuiz();
  assert.equal(api.state.examCount, 1);
});

test('expired exams finish once, including after reloading their saved session', () => {
  const env = environment();
  env.api.startExam();
  const saved = env.saved;
  const resumed = environment({ raw: saved });
  resumed.advance(30 * 60 * 1000 + 1);
  resumed.api.tickTimer();
  assert.equal(resumed.api.state.active, null);
  assert.equal(resumed.api.state.examCount, 1);
  assert.equal(resumed.api.lastResult.timedOut, true);
  assert.equal(resumed.api.lastResult.unanswered, 50);
  resumed.api.tickTimer();
  assert.equal(resumed.api.state.examCount, 1);
});

test('malformed JSON and null session items recover without disabling storage', () => {
  for (const raw of ['{invalid', JSON.stringify({ version: 1, active: { mode: 'practice', title: 'Broken', items: [null], position: 0, startedAt: Date.now(), answers: {} } })]) {
    const env = environment({ raw });
    assert.equal(env.api.state.active, null);
    assert.equal(env.api.storageAvailable, true);
    env.api.saveProgress();
    assert.equal(env.writes, 1);
    assert.equal(JSON.parse(env.saved).version, 1);
  }
});

test('denied localStorage still permits in-memory practice', () => {
  const env = environment({ denied: true });
  const q = questions[0];
  assert.equal(env.api.storageAvailable, false);
  env.api.createSession([q], 'practice', 'Offline memory');
  env.api.submitAnswer(q.correctAnswer);
  assert.equal(env.api.state.total, 1);
  assert.equal(env.api.state.correct, 1);
  assert.equal(env.writes, 0);
});

test('favorites toggle and survive a reload', () => {
  const env = environment();
  env.api.toggleFavorite(1);
  env.api.toggleFavorite(1);
  assert.equal(env.api.state.favoriteIds.length, 0);
  env.api.toggleFavorite(2);
  const resumed = environment({ raw: env.saved });
  assert.deepEqual([...resumed.api.state.favoriteIds], [2]);
});

test('daily question selection is stable on the same date', () => {
  const a = environment(), b = environment();
  a.api.startDaily(); b.api.startDaily();
  assert.equal(a.api.state.active.items.length, 10);
  assert.deepEqual([...a.api.state.active.items].map(q => q.id), [...b.api.state.active.items].map(q => q.id));
  assert.equal(new Set(a.api.state.active.items.map(q => q.id)).size, 10);
});

test('earned80 survives history truncation, reload, and legacy history migration', () => {
  const env = environment();
  const q = questions[0];
  env.api.createSession([q], 'practice', 'Achievement');
  env.api.submitAnswer(q.correctAnswer);
  env.api.finishQuiz();
  assert.equal(env.api.state.earned80, true);
  env.api.state.history = Array.from({ length: 50 }, () => ({ title: 'Later session', mode: 'practice', total: 10, correct: 0, endedAt: Date.now() }));
  env.api.saveProgress();
  assert.equal(environment({ raw: env.saved }).api.state.earned80, true);
  const legacy = env.api.blankProgress();
  delete legacy.earned80;
  legacy.history = [{ title: 'Old achievement', mode: 'practice', total: 10, correct: 8, endedAt: Date.now() }];
  assert.equal(environment({ raw: JSON.stringify(legacy) }).api.state.earned80, true);
});

test('reset requires confirmation, cancel preserves data, confirm preserves only theme', () => {
  const env = environment();
  env.api.state.theme = 'dark';
  env.api.toggleFavorite(1);
  env.api.createSession([questions[0]], 'practice', 'Reset test');
  env.api.submitAnswer(questions[0].correctAnswer);
  env.api.resetProgress();
  assert.equal(env.api.state.total, 1);
  env.api.closeConfirm();
  assert.equal(env.api.state.total, 1);
  env.api.resetProgress();
  const confirm = env.api.confirmCallback;
  env.api.closeConfirm();
  confirm();
  assert.equal(env.api.state.total, 0);
  assert.equal(env.api.state.favoriteIds.length, 0);
  assert.equal(env.api.state.active, null);
  assert.equal(env.api.state.theme, 'dark');
  assert.equal(JSON.parse(env.saved).total, 0);
});

test('image dialog uses local assets, isolates background and leaves quiz answers untouched', () => {
  const env = environment();
  const q = questions.find(q => q.image);
  assert(q, 'Expected generated illustrations');
  env.api.createSession([q], 'practice', 'Image test');
  const before = JSON.stringify(env.api.state);
  env.api.showImage(q.id);
  assert.equal(env.api.imageDialogOpen, true);
  assert.equal(env.element('#main-content').inert, true);
  assert(env.element('#modal-root').innerHTML.includes(q.image));
  assert(env.element('#modal-root').innerHTML.includes('aria-modal="true"'));
  env.api.closeConfirm();
  assert.equal(env.api.imageDialogOpen, false);
  assert.equal(env.element('#main-content').inert, false);
  assert.equal(env.element('#modal-root').innerHTML, '');
  assert.equal(JSON.stringify(env.api.state), before);
  assert.equal(env.api.questionImage({image:null}), '');
  for (const image of ['https://example.com/a.svg','images/../secret.svg','data:image/svg+xml,abc']) {
    assert.equal(env.api.hasLocalImage({image}), false);
    assert.equal(env.api.questionImage({image}), '');
  }
});

test('exam deadline closes an enlarged image and records the exam exactly once', () => {
  const env = environment();
  env.api.startExam();
  env.api.showImage(questions.find(q => q.image).id);
  env.advance(31 * 60000);
  env.api.tickTimer();
  assert.equal(env.api.imageDialogOpen, false);
  assert.equal(env.api.state.examCount, 1);
  env.api.tickTimer();
  assert.equal(env.api.state.examCount, 1);
});

console.log(`\n${passed} validation groups passed.`);
```

## illustrations/README.md

```
# Zelfgemaakte verkeersillustraties

Alle afbeeldingen zijn lokaal getekend, zonder externe media. Bouw de complete verzameling opnieuw op met eerst `node traffic-images.js` en daarna `node illustrations/extra.cjs`. De eerste opdracht schrijft de 117 basis-SVG’s en afbeeldingsvelden in `questions.js`; de tweede bouwt 100 SVG’s voor de uitbreiding, werkt het gezamenlijke manifest bij en genereert de galerij. Voer ze in deze volgorde uit. De browser heeft deze generatoren niet nodig.

## Tekencontract

Canvas 800 × 500. Noord is boven. Positieve rotatie is met de klok mee. Voertuigen wijzen bij 0 graden naar boven, 90 naar rechts, 180 beneden, 270 links. Nederlands rechts rijden: op een verticale weg rijdt de rechterhelft omhoog, op een horizontale weg de onderste helft naar rechts.

Elke module exporteert `module.exports = h => [...]` met records `{ id, alt, svg, note }`. `svg` is de inhoud zonder buitenste svg-tag. `note` is een korte controle van koppeling met de vraag, geen tekst in de afbeelding. Lees voor ieder record de originele vraag, opties en uitleg in questions.js. Geen antwoord verklappende teksten of markeringen. Blauwe auto is de bestuurder (JIJ), andere auto's amber/wit. Alle pijlen zijn wit/grijs en geven alleen bedoelde richting weer.

Tekenfuncties (allemaal retourneren SVG-string):

- `h.base(type)` type `cross`, `vertical`, `horizontal`, `motorway`, `roundabout`, `curve`, `blank`. Met groen terrein en stoepen. Verticale rijbaan x290..510; horizontaal y150..350; kruis heeft beide, midden zonder lijnen. Verticale lanes: x345 zuidwaarts, x455 noordwaarts. Horizontaal: y200 westwaarts, y300 oostwaarts. Motorway: x180..620, omhoogrijdende lanes x250/370/490, vluchtstrook x580; rijstrooklijnen x310/430/550. Roundabout centrum(400,250), buitenradius155, binnenradius90, toegangen boven/onder/links/rechts. Curve bocht van (455,500) via (455,250) naar (800,200).
- `h.rect(x,y,w,h,fill,rx=0,extra='')`, `h.line(x1,y1,x2,y2,stroke='#fff',width=4,extra='')`, `h.path(d,fill='none',stroke='#fff',width=4,extra='')`, `h.circle(x,y,r,fill,extra='')`, `h.text(x,y,label,size=18,fill='#25334b',extra='')`. escape automatisch bij text.
- `h.car(x,y,angle=0,color='blue',label='',kind='car',opts={})`. Color blue/amber/white/red/gray of hex. kind car/van/truck/bus/ambulance/tractor/motorcycle. opts.door (open bestuurdersdeur links), opts.indicator 'left'/'right', opts.brake true. Afmetingen gewone auto44×76 gecentreerd, van48×94, bus54×128. Label 'JIJ' op het autodak (meedraaiend). Geen label indien onbekend perspectief.
- `h.bike(x,y,angle=0,color='#25334b')` 20×44. `h.person(x,y,color='#de9a55',scale=1)` van boven. `h.tree(x,y,r=28)`, `h.building(x,y,w,h)`, `h.label(x,y,text)` kleine neutrale straat-/objectaanduiding.
- `h.zebra(x,y,width=130,angle=0)` strepen over horizontale breedte, dus over verticale rijbaan. `h.teeth(x,y,count=4,angle=0)` driehoeken punt omlaag, naar verkeer dat vanuit beneden nadert. `h.arrow(x,y,angle=0,turn='straight')` witte intentiepijl omhoog of left/right. `h.light(x,y,state='red')` in kader met drie lampen; h.sign(code,x,y,size=64) op paaltje, symbool hergebruikt uit sign module. Voor onbekende code fallback tekst is NIET toegestaan: gebruik alleen de geleverde codes.
- `h.weather(type)` rain/fog/snow/ice/night/sun/wind, transparante passende weereffecten over scene. Weather heeft geen antwoordtekst. `h.rail(y=250)` horizontale spoorbaan.

Signmodule exporteert `{ symbols, files, questions }`, symbols is een object code→SVG-inhoud in viewBox0 0 120 120; files code→Nederlandse bestandsnaam; questions(h) geeft records. Root renderer definieert `h.sign` daarmee. Gebruik codes A1, B1,B2,B6,B7,C1,C2,C3,C7,C11,C12,D1,D2,D4,D5,D6,D7,E1,E2,F1,G1,G3,G5,J21,L2,L3. A1 standaard50; kan expliciet ander getal tekenen met eigen helper.
```

## illustrations/extra.cjs

```
'use strict';

// Adds a question-specific, locally rendered scene for each illustrated extension item.
// Run after traffic-images.js to rebuild the complete 217-image manifest/gallery.
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const vm = require('node:vm');
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const esc = value => String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&apos;' }[c]));
const R = (x, y, w, h, fill, extra = '') => `<rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="${h}" fill="${fill}" ${extra}/>`;
const L = (x, y, x2, y2, stroke, width = 4, extra = '') => `<path d="M${x} ${y}L${x2} ${y2}" fill="none" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="${width}" ${extra}/>`;
const C = (x, y, r, fill, extra = '') => `<circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="${r}" fill="${fill}" ${extra}/>`;
const T = (x, y, value, size = 17, fill = '#223247', extra = '') => `<text x="${x}" y="${y}" fill="${fill}" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="${size}" ${extra}>${esc(value)}</text>`;
const tree = (x, y, r) => `<path d="M${x} ${y + r}v${r + 12}" stroke="#748e78" stroke-width="5"/><circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="${r}" fill="#91b39a"/><circle cx="${x - r * .38}" cy="${y + 3}" r="${r * .55}" fill="#a4c4a5"/>`;
const car = (x, y, color = '#3459e6', label = 'JIJ', direction = 'up', kind = 'car') => {
  const width = kind === 'truck' ? 58 : kind === 'bus' ? 55 : 44;
  const height = kind === 'truck' ? 115 : kind === 'bus' ? 110 : 76;
  const angle = direction === 'down' ? 180 : direction === 'left' ? -90 : direction === 'right' ? 90 : 0;
  return `<g transform="translate(${x} ${y}) rotate(${angle})"><rect x="${-width / 2 - 3}" y="${-height / 2 + 12}" width="${width + 6}" height="${height - 24}" rx="7" fill="#253244"/><rect x="${-width / 2}" y="${-height / 2}" width="${width}" height="${height}" rx="9" fill="${color}" stroke="#26354a" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="${-width / 2 + 5}" y="${-height / 2 + 15}" width="${width - 10}" height="16" rx="4" fill="#d9edf1"/><rect x="${-width / 2 + 5}" y="${height / 2 - 29}" width="${width - 10}" height="13" rx="3" fill="#d9edf1"/><path d="M${-width / 2 + 4} ${-height / 2 + 5}h9m${width - 22} 0h9" stroke="#fff1bf" stroke-width="4"/><text x="0" y="4" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#fff">${esc(label)}</text></g>`;
};
const bicycle = (x, y, color = '#26384a') => `<g stroke="${color}" fill="none" stroke-width="4"><circle cx="${x - 14}" cy="${y + 10}" r="10"/><circle cx="${x + 15}" cy="${y + 10}" r="10"/><path d="m${x - 14} ${y + 10} 11-21 12 21h-23l12-21m-3 0h12m-1 0 9-3"/><circle cx="${x + 3}" cy="${y - 18}" r="4" fill="${color}" stroke="none"/></g>`;
const walker = (x, y) => `<circle cx="${x}" cy="${y - 14}" r="6" fill="#27394b"/><path d="m${x} ${y - 8}-3 19m2-13 12 5m-13 8-9 17m10-17 9 17" stroke="#27394b" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
const arrow = (x, y, direction, color = '#fff', size = 1) => {
  const paths = { up: 'M0 20V-22m-15 15L0 -22 15 -7', down: 'M0 -20V22m-15-15L0 22 15 7', left: 'M20 0H-22m15-15L-22 0l15 15', right: 'M-20 0h42M7-15 22 0 7 15' };
  return `<path d="${paths[direction]}" transform="translate(${x} ${y}) scale(${size})" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`;
};
const background = (id, wet = false) => {
  const trees = [tree(54, 75 + id % 40, 22), tree(746, 115 + id % 33, 25), tree(72, 422 - id % 31, 24), tree(725, 395 - id % 27, 21)].join('');
  const clouds = id % 4 === 0 ? '<path d="M94 80q9-18 26-5 12-18 25 0 19-3 18 13H94Z" fill="#fff" opacity=".68"/>' : '';
  const rain = wet ? `<g stroke="#a6c4dd" stroke-width="3" opacity=".58">${Array.from({ length: 13 }, (_, i) => L(38 + (i * 61 + id * 3) % 730, 20, 25 + (i * 61 + id * 3) % 730, 42, '#a6c4dd', 3)).join('')}</g>` : '';
  return R(0, 0, 800, 500, wet ? '#cbd9df' : '#e6eee5') + clouds + trees + rain;
};
function signSymbol(q) {
  const p = q.question.toLowerCase();
  const red = '#d63e46', blue = '#175ca8', dark = '#222c38';
  if (p.includes('a2')) return `<circle cx="0" cy="0" r="54" fill="#fff" stroke="${red}" stroke-width="11"/><text x="0" y="14" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-size="38" font-weight="700" fill="${dark}">30</text><path d="m-38 42 76-84" stroke="${red}" stroke-width="8"/>`;
  if (p.includes('c19')) return `<circle cx="0" cy="0" r="54" fill="#fff" stroke="${red}" stroke-width="11"/><text x="0" y="-2" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-size="27" font-weight="700" fill="${dark}">2,0</text><text x="0" y="23" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-size="15" fill="${dark}">m</text>`;
  if (p.includes('a1') || p.includes('maximumsnelheidsbord')) return `<circle cx="0" cy="0" r="54" fill="#fff" stroke="${red}" stroke-width="11"/><text x="0" y="14" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-size="38" font-weight="700" fill="${dark}">50</text>`;
  if (p.includes('g12a') || (p.includes('fiets') && p.includes('bromfiets') && p.includes('rond blauw'))) return C(0, 0, 55, blue) + `<g fill="white"><circle cx="-21" cy="11" r="12" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="5"/><circle cx="10" cy="11" r="12" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="5"/><path d="m-21 11 11-23 14 23h-25l11-23m-3 0h11" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="4"/><circle cx="27" cy="-20" r="4"/><path d="m25-14-8 14 13 4 7 12m-20-16-10 14" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/></g>`;
  if (p.includes('losse steenslag') || p.includes('steentjes')) return `<path d="M0-61 59 47h-118Z" fill="#fff" stroke="${red}" stroke-width="9"/><g fill="${dark}"><circle cx="-15" cy="15" r="6"/><circle cx="4" cy="1" r="5"/><circle cx="20" cy="24" r="5"/><path d="m-22-6 6-11 5 12m21-14 6 13 6-11"/></g>`;
  if (p.includes('c1') || p.includes('toegangsverbod') || p.includes('geslotenverklaring')) return `<circle cx="0" cy="0" r="54" fill="#fff" stroke="${red}" stroke-width="11"/>`;
  if (p.includes('b6') || p.includes('haaientanden')) return `<path d="M-59-46h118L0 60Z" fill="#fff" stroke="${red}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`;
  if (p.includes('b7') || p.includes('stop')) return `<path d="M-34-56h68l47 47v68L34 106h-68l-47-47v-68Z" transform="scale(.75)" fill="${red}"/><text x="0" y="8" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="white">STOP</text>`;
  if (p.includes('b1')) return `<path d="M0-60 60 0 0 60-60 0Z" fill="#f5d138" stroke="#26313c" stroke-width="5"/>`;
  if (p.includes('b2')) return `<path d="M0-60 60 0 0 60-60 0Z" fill="#f5d138" stroke="#26313c" stroke-width="5"/><path d="m-38 38 76-76" stroke="#26313c" stroke-width="8"/>`;
  if (p.includes('andreaskruis')) return `<path d="m-46-53 92 106m0-106L-46 53" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="24"/><path d="m-46-53 92 106m0-106L-46 53" stroke="#d73b40" stroke-width="8"/>`;
  if (p.includes('f5')) return `<path d="M-30 50V-43m-15 15 15-15 15 15" stroke="${red}" stroke-width="12" fill="none"/><path d="M31-50V42m-15-15 15 15 15-15" stroke="#222c38" stroke-width="12" fill="none"/>`;
  if (p.includes('f2')) return `<circle cx="0" cy="0" r="54" fill="#fff" stroke="#657181" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M-38-18h34v24h-34Zm37 5h18l13 13v12H-1Z" fill="#263342"/><path d="M5-36h34v24H5Zm37 5h14l10 11v8H42Z" fill="#3971bd"/><circle cx="-26" cy="12" r="6" fill="#263342"/><circle cx="16" cy="12" r="6" fill="#263342"/><circle cx="18" cy="-4" r="6" fill="#263342"/><circle cx="53" cy="-4" r="6" fill="#263342"/>`;
  if (p.includes('e7')) return R(-50, -50, 100, 100, blue, 'rx="8"') + `<path d="M-32 7h39v25h-39Zm39 7h21l13 14v7H7Z" fill="white"/><circle cx="-22" cy="34" r="6" fill="white"/><circle cx="30" cy="34" r="6" fill="white"/>`;

  if (p.includes('rijstrooklicht') && p.includes('witte pijl')) return R(-62, -43, 124, 86, '#27364a', 'rx="8"') + `<path d="M-34 10 20-20m-5 1 18 1-5 17" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`;

function signScene(q) {

}
function junctionScene(q) {

  if (/uitritconstructie/i.test(p)) s += R(290, 78, 220, 35, '#d8d0c3') + R(290, 78, 220, 12, '#f6f3eb') + T(400, 67, 'DOORLOPEND TROTTOIR', 10, '#33465a', 'text-anchor="middle" font-weight="700"');
  if (/militaire colonne/i.test(p)) {

    s += R(517, 96, 32, 78, '#35445a', 'rx="5"') + C(533, 115, 8, '#d9474a') + C(533, 136, 7, '#c6a958') + C(533, 156, 7, '#64886e');
  }

  if (fromLeft && !/tram/i.test(p)) s += car(110, 236, '#d87567', 'AUTO', 'right');

}
function speedScene(q) {
  const id = q.id, p = q.question.toLowerCase(), wet = /regen|nat|glad|mist|aquaplaning/i.test(p);
  let s = background(id, wet);
  const slant = id % 3;
  s += R(0, 290, 800, 210, '#d7ddde') + R(0, 322, 800, 132, '#657486');
  s += L(0, 388 + slant * 4, 800, 388 + slant * 4, '#f7f4e8', 4, 'stroke-dasharray="30 22"');
  s += car(392, 408, '#3459e6', 'JIJ', 'right');

  const cx = 633, cy = 188;
  s += L(cx, cy + 57, cx, 297, '#758598', 7) + C(cx, cy, 55, '#fff', 'stroke="#d63e46" stroke-width="11"') + T(cx, cy + 12, digits, 36, '#293749', 'text-anchor="middle" font-weight="700"');
  if (/blauw vierkant|adviessnelheid/i.test(p)) s = s.replace(/<circle cx="633" cy="188"[^>]*>.*?<\/circle>/, R(cx - 55, cy - 55, 110, 110, '#175ca8', 'rx="8"') + C(cx, cy, 43, '#fff') + T(cx, cy + 12, digits, 33, '#293749', 'text-anchor="middle" font-weight="700"'));
  if (/aanhanger|caravan/i.test(p)) s += `<path d="M431 406h27" stroke="#25364a" stroke-width="7"/>${R(457, 381, 57, 47, '#d8e0e5', 'rx="8" stroke="#26364a" stroke-width="3"')}${C(470, 432, 6, '#27374a')}${C(501, 432, 6, '#27374a')}`;
  if (/woon-erf|woonerf/i.test(p)) s += R(34, 52, 186, 56, '#f7f9f8', 'rx="8"') + T(127, 86, 'WOONERF', 15, '#31445a', 'text-anchor="middle" font-weight="700"');
  s += T(31, 477, wet ? 'WEGDEK EN ZICHT BEÏNVLOEDEN DE KEUZE' : 'MAXIMUMSNELHEID · BORD EN WEGSITUATIE', 12, '#fff', 'font-weight="700"');
  return s;
}
function highwayScene(q) {
  const id = q.id, p = q.question.toLowerCase(), wet = /regen|mist|nat/i.test(p);
  let s = background(id, wet);
  const lanes = 2 + id % 3, roadLeft = 149, roadWidth = 502;
  s += R(0, 0, 800, 500, wet ? '#cbd9df' : '#e4ece3') + R(roadLeft - 20, 0, roadWidth + 40, 500, '#d1d8dc') + R(roadLeft, 0, roadWidth, 500, '#677587');
  for (let i = 1; i < lanes; i++) {
    const x = roadLeft + (roadWidth / lanes) * i;
    s += L(x, 0, x, 500, '#f5f2e7', 4, `stroke-dasharray="${23 + (id % 5)} 18"`);
  }
  s += L(roadLeft, 0, roadLeft, 500, '#f5f2e7', 4) + L(roadLeft + roadWidth, 0, roadLeft + roadWidth, 500, '#f5f2e7', 4);
  const laneX = (lane) => roadLeft + roadWidth * (lane + .5) / lanes;
  s += car(laneX(Math.max(0, lanes - 1)), 410, '#3459e6', 'JIJ', 'up');
  if (/invoeg/i.test(p)) {
    s += R(667, 0, 133, 500, '#d0d8db') + R(687, 0, 87, 500, '#718095') + L(687, 0, 687, 500, '#fff', 4, 'stroke-dasharray="18 18"');
    s += car(725, 265, '#e4aa54', 'AUTO', 'up') + arrow(706, 347, 'left', '#fff', .7);
  } else if (/uitvoeg|afrit/i.test(p)) {
    s += `<path d="M535 500 Q535 330 660 255 T810 170" fill="none" stroke="#d1d8dc" stroke-width="132"/><path d="M535 500 Q535 330 660 255 T810 170" fill="none" stroke="#718095" stroke-width="88"/><path d="M535 500 Q535 330 660 255 T810 170" fill="none" stroke="#f5f2e7" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="20 18"/>`;
    s += arrow(561, 340, 'right', '#fff', .7);
  } else if (/rode kruis|kruis/i.test(p)) {
    s += R(265, 34, 150, 75, '#34445b', 'rx="8"') + T(340, 88, '×', 64, '#ef5e57', 'text-anchor="middle" font-weight="700"');
  } else if (/fiets/i.test(p)) {
    s += bicycle(440, 242, '#edc45d');
  }
  if (/tegenligger|inhalen|inhaal/i.test(p)) s += car(laneX(0), 147, '#e8aa51', 'AUTO', 'down');
  if (/bus/i.test(p)) s += car(laneX(Math.max(0, lanes - 2)), 225, '#c8786e', 'BUS', 'down', 'bus');
  if (/vrachtwagen|combinatie|aanhanger/i.test(p)) s += car(laneX(Math.max(0, lanes - 2)), 180, '#d9ded9', 'VRACHT', 'up', 'truck');
  s += T(30, 477, 'RIJSTROKEN · SCHEMATISCH BOVENAANZICHT', 12, '#fff', 'font-weight="700"');
  return s;
}
function makeSvg(q) {
  let drawing;
  if (q.illustrationKind === 'sign') drawing = signScene(q);
  else if (q.illustrationKind === 'junction') drawing = junctionScene(q);
  else if (q.illustrationKind === 'speed') drawing = speedScene(q);
  else drawing = highwayScene(q);
  return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="800" height="500" role="img"><title>${esc(q.imageAlt)}</title>${drawing}</svg>\n`;
}

const context = { window: {} };
vm.runInNewContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'questions-extra.js'), 'utf8'), context);
const questions = context.window.THEORY_QUESTIONS_EXTRA.filter(q => q.image);
if (questions.length !== 100) throw new Error(`Expected 100 illustrated extension questions, found ${questions.length}`);
for (const q of questions) {
  const svg = makeSvg(q);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, q.image), svg);
}
const manifestPath = path.join(__dirname, 'manifest.json');
const existing = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(manifestPath, 'utf8'));
const additions = questions.map(q => ({ id: q.id, image: q.image, alt: q.imageAlt, note: `Zelfgetekende ${q.illustrationKind}-situatie; gekoppeld aan vraag ${q.id}. Elementen tonen alleen de situatie uit de vraag en markeren geen juist antwoord.` }));
const combined = [...existing.filter(row => !questions.some(q => q.id === row.id)), ...additions].sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id);
fs.writeFileSync(manifestPath, JSON.stringify(combined, null, 2) + '\n');
const gallery = combined.map(row => ({ ...row, question: row.id > 220 ? questions.find(q => q.id === row.id)?.question : null }));
const cards = gallery.map(row => `<figure><img loading="lazy" src="../${row.image}" alt="${esc(row.alt)}"><figcaption><strong>Vraag ${row.id}</strong>${row.question ? ` ${esc(row.question)}` : ''}</figcaption></figure>`).join('');
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'overzicht.html'), `<!doctype html><html lang="nl"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Eigen verkeersillustraties — overzicht</title><style>*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;padding:20px;font:14px Arial,sans-serif;background:#f2f5f8;color:#25334b}header{max-width:1500px;margin:0 auto 20px}main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;max-width:1500px;margin:auto}figure{margin:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce2e9;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden}img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}figcaption{padding:10px 12px;line-height:1.45;min-height:55px}strong{color:#3459e6}@media(max-width:850px){main{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}@media(max-width:480px){body{padding:10px}main{grid-template-columns:1fr}}</style><header><h1>${combined.length} eigen verkeersillustraties</h1><p>Zelfgetekende situaties bij verkeersvragen. Tekens en posities tonen de casus, niet het antwoord.</p><a href="../index.html">Naar de trainer</a></header><main>${cards}</main></html>\n`);
console.log(`${questions.length} extra SVG's gemaakt; manifest bevat nu ${combined.length} illustraties.`);

```
'use strict';

// Original, question-specific vector scenes. North is up; all intent arrows are neutral.
module.exports = h => {
  const records = [];
  const add = (id, alt, note, ...layers) => records.push({ id, alt, note, svg: layers.flat().join('') });
  const asphalt = '#6e7c8d', curb = '#d2d9de', white = '#fbfaf0';
  const dash = 'stroke-dasharray="22 18"';
  const roadV = () => h.base('blank') + h.rect(282,0,236,500,'#a9bba6') + h.rect(290,0,220,500,asphalt) + h.line(400,0,400,500,white,3,dash) + h.line(296,0,296,500,white,3) + h.line(504,0,504,500,white,3);
  const roadH = () => h.base('blank') + h.rect(0,142,800,216,'#a9bba6') + h.rect(0,150,800,200,asphalt) + h.line(0,250,800,250,white,3,dash) + h.line(0,156,800,156,white,3) + h.line(0,344,800,344,white,3);
  const town = () => h.building(40,35,135,65) + h.building(615,30,140,70) + h.building(40,405,135,65) + h.tree(650,430,24);
  const fields = () => [42,67,92,117].map(y => h.line(25,y,240,y,'#b5c99a',9)).join('') + [382,407,432,457].map(y => h.line(560,y,775,y,'#c9cf9e',9)).join('') + h.tree(650,70,27) + h.tree(735,95,22);
  const speedSign = (n,x,y,size=72) => h.line(x,y,x,y+size*.85,'#7e8a96',5) + h.circle(x,y,size*.44,'white',`stroke="#d72f3b" stroke-width="${size*.08}"`) + h.text(x,y+size*.12,n,size*.35,'#25334b','text-anchor="middle" font-weight="700"');
  const intent = (d, tip, angle=0) => h.path(d,'none',white,5,'stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"') + `<g transform="translate(${tip[0]} ${tip[1]}) rotate(${angle})">${h.path('M-9 12L0 0 9 12','none',white,5,'stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"')}</g>`;
  const lotBay = (x,y,w=78,ht=128) => h.path(`M${x} ${y}v${ht}h${w}V${y}`,'none',white,3);
  const hatch = (x,y,w,ht) => h.rect(x,y,w,ht,asphalt,0,'stroke="#fbfaf0" stroke-width="3"') + Array.from({length:Math.floor(ht/26)},(_,i)=>h.line(x+5,y+8+i*26,x+w-5,y+27+i*26,white,5)).join('');
  const officer = (x,y) => `<g transform="translate(${x} ${y})">${h.line(-7,16,-11,39,'#344760',7)}${h.line(8,16,12,39,'#344760',7)}${h.rect(-17,-11,34,34,'#eead47',5)}${h.rect(-17,2,34,6,'#f6f5dc')}${h.line(-19,-4,-34,10,'#344760',8)}${h.line(18,-5,31,-30,'#344760',8)}${h.circle(32,-35,7,'#f8f4e7')}${h.circle(0,-24,12,'#efc8a3')}${h.rect(-13,-36,26,7,'#344760',3)}</g>`;

  add(1,
    'Gelijkwaardig kruispunt zonder borden. De blauwe auto nadert van onderen en wil rechtdoor; een amberkleurige auto komt van rechts.',
    'Blauw noordwaarts x455; auto van rechts westwaarts y200. Geen voorrangstekens.',
    h.base('cross'), town(), h.car(455,421,0,'blue','JIJ'), h.arrow(455,350), h.car(658,200,270,'amber'), h.arrow(568,200,270));

  add(2,
    'Twee verharde wegen kruisen elkaar. Een blauwe auto rijdt naar het kruispunt; van rechts nadert een fietser die rechtdoor wil.',
    'Fietser rijdt op de noordelijke helft westwaarts, niet op een los fietspad; gelijkwaardige aansluiting.',
    h.base('cross'), h.building(54,30,172,70), h.tree(680,435), h.tree(185,421,24),
    h.car(455,425,0,'blue','JIJ'), h.arrow(455,356), h.bike(641,184,270,'#d7a24f'), h.arrow(559,184,270), h.person(242,90));

  add(3,
    'Een blauwe auto rijdt over een verharde buitenweg. Rechts sluit een onverharde weg aan, waaruit een amberkleurige auto nadert.',
    'T-aansluiting onverhard zonder doorlopend trottoir of uitritdrempel. Van rechts komt de andere auto.',

function questions(h) {

    'G1 herkenbaar als witte wegen met viaduct op blauw; geen snelheidsgetal toegevoegd.');
  add(53, 'Een blauw vierkant bord met de voorkant van een witte auto. Rechts loopt een weg met twee rijrichtingen.',
    scene('G3', 'vertical', h.car(455, 400, 0, 'blue', 'JIJ') + h.sign('G3', 555, 221, 69) + h.car(345, 113, 180, 'white')),
    'G3 witte auto op blauw; geen autosnelwegsymbool.');
  add(54, 'Een blauw vierkant bord met een huis, een klein persoon, een bal en een auto. Rechts staan woningen aan een smalle straat.',
    scene('G5', 'vertical', h.rect(292, 0, 216, 500, '#a7a9a4') + Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => h.line(293, i * 44, 507, i * 44, '#babcb6', 2)).join('') + h.car(455, 408, 0, 'blue', 'JIJ') + h.sign('G5', 551, 212, 74) + h.building(608, 140, 120, 100) + h.person(553, 335)),
    'G5 erf met wooncontext, maar geen parkeersuggestie of gemarkeerd correct parkeervak.');
  add(55, 'Een driehoekig bord met rode rand en twee zwarte lopende figuren van verschillende grootte. Rechts is een straat met een schoolgebouw.',
    scene('J21', 'vertical', h.car(455, 413, 0, 'blue', 'JIJ') + h.sign('J21', 553, 210, 70) + h.building(606, 145, 137, 123) + h.rect(620, 278, 110, 68, '#d8c7ac', 6) + h.person(551, 313, '#e0a15b', .75)),
    'J21 twee kinderen; geen oversteekplaats of verplicht voetpad toegevoegd.');
  add(56, 'Een rond wit bord met rode rand en het zwarte getal 50. Een blauwe auto rijdt op de weg naast het bord.',
    scene('A1', 'vertical', h.car(455, 411, 0, 'blue', 'JIJ') + h.sign('A1', 552, 213, 65) + h.building(610, 170, 127, 80)),
    'A1 gebruikt 50 als concreet zichtbaar getal; geen minimum- of adviesvorm.');
  add(57, 'Een rond wit bord met rode rand en twee autosymbolen, links rood en rechts zwart. Op de weg rijden een blauwe en een witte auto achter elkaar.',
    scene('F1', 'vertical', h.car(455, 417, 0, 'blue', 'JIJ') + h.car(455, 205, 0, 'white') + h.sign('F1', 552, 276, 66)),
    'F1 kleurenvolgorde rood links, zwart rechts. Auto blijft achter voorligger.');
  add(58, 'Een blauw rechthoekig bord met een zwart bussymbool in een wit vlak. Rechts staat een bus langs een stoep met een wachthokje.',
    scene('L3', 'vertical', h.car(455, 403, 0, 'blue', 'JIJ') + h.car(475, 177, 0, 'white', '', 'bus') + h.sign('L3', 555, 183, 77) + h.rect(591, 141, 82, 76, '#c3d8df', 4, 'stroke="#768b96" stroke-width="4"') + h.rect(600, 190, 64, 9, '#8b9ca9', 2) + h.person(550, 265)),
    'L3 blauw-wit bord met zwarte bus. Bus en wachtplek dienen als visuele context.');

  // Road-marking questions: seven independent overhead situations.
  add(59, 'Een blauwe auto rijdt achter een witte auto. Een ononderbroken witte middenlijn scheidt hen van een tegemoetkomende amberkleurige auto.',
    h.base('vertical') + h.rect(391, 0, 18, 500, '#687684') + h.line(400, 0, 400, 500, '#fff', 5) + h.car(455, 398, 0, 'blue', 'JIJ') + h.car(455, 217, 0, 'white') + h.car(345, 87, 180, 'amber') + h.tree(205, 90, 43) + h.tree(637, 360, 52),
    'Één doorgetrokken middenstreep zonder onderbroken buur; bestuurder blijft rechts.');
  add(60, 'Een blauwe auto rijdt rechts van twee witte middenlijnen. De lijn direct naast deze auto is onderbroken; de andere lijn is ononderbroken.',
    h.base('vertical') + h.rect(383, 0, 34, 500, '#687684') + h.line(391, 0, 391, 500, '#fff', 5) + h.line(409, 0, 409, 500, '#fff', 5, 'stroke-dasharray="28 24"') + h.car(455, 403, 0, 'blue', 'JIJ') + h.car(455, 161, 0, 'gray') + h.tree(648, 118, 48) + h.building(95, 320, 125, 93),
    'Onderbroken lijn x409 ligt aan bestuurderskant x455; geen inhaalbeweging getekend.');
  add(61, 'Een blauwe auto nadert een kruispunt. Vlak voor de dwarsstraat staat een rij witte driehoeken op de eigen weghelft. Een amberkleurige auto nadert van rechts.',
    h.base('cross') + h.teeth(413, 363, 5) + h.car(455, 431, 0, 'blue', 'JIJ') + h.car(663, 200, 270, 'amber') + h.car(154, 300, 90, 'white') + h.tree(146, 63, 45) + h.tree(669, 420, 47),
    'Haaientanden alleen op eigen aanrijstrook; geen STOP-bord of stopstreep.');
  add(62, 'Langs de rechterrand van een straat loopt een ononderbroken gele streep. Een blauwe auto rijdt op de rijbaan en naast de stoep staan gebouwen.',
    h.base('vertical') + h.line(506, 25, 506, 475, '#f2cb49', 7) + h.car(455, 378, 0, 'blue', 'JIJ') + h.car(345, 113, 180, 'white') + h.building(585, 60, 150, 110) + h.building(585, 258, 150, 130) + h.person(550, 220),
    'Gele doorgetrokken kantmarkering. Geen uit-/instappende persoon, geen correct/fout parkeergedrag.');
  add(63, 'Langs de rechterrand van de rijbaan liggen losse gele streepstukken. Een blauwe auto rijdt langs een stoep met woningen en een boom.',
    h.base('vertical') + h.line(506, 18, 506, 490, '#f2cb49', 7, 'stroke-dasharray="36 23"') + h.car(455, 390, 0, 'blue', 'JIJ') + h.building(590, 65, 135, 110) + h.tree(647, 299, 47) + h.car(345, 194, 180, 'amber') + h.person(550, 252),
    'Duidelijk onderbroken gele kantmarkering; geen doorgetrokken gele delen.');
  add(64, 'Een snelweg met drie rijstroken en een portaal met drie donkere signaalpanelen. Op het rechterpaneel brandt een rood kruis. Een blauwe auto nadert over de middelste strook.',
    h.base('motorway') + h.rect(160, 123, 476, 10, '#adbac5', 4) + h.rect(162, 121, 10, 70, '#8d9ca9', 3) + h.rect(624, 121, 10, 70, '#8d9ca9', 3) + [250,370,490].map(x => h.rect(x - 35, 97, 70, 62, '#202f3c', 6, 'stroke="#dce3e9" stroke-width="3"')).join('') + h.line(474, 110, 506, 146, '#fa4a4b', 7) + h.line(506, 110, 474, 146, '#fa4a4b', 7) + h.car(370, 405, 0, 'blue', 'JIJ') + h.car(250, 251, 0, 'white') + h.tree(718, 367, 43),
    'Rood kruis uitsluitend als werkelijk matrixsignaal boven rechter rijstrook, niet als antwoordmarkering.');
  add(65, 'Een blauwe auto staat op de linker van twee voorsorteerstroken in dezelfde rijrichting. Voor die auto staat een witte pijl naar links; in de strook ernaast staat een pijl rechtdoor.',
    h.base('cross') + h.rect(288, 350, 224, 150, '#687684') + h.line(291, 351, 291, 500, '#fff', 4) + h.line(508, 351, 508, 500, '#fff', 4) + h.line(400, 350, 400, 500, '#fff', 4, 'stroke-dasharray="20 16"') + h.arrow(345, 369, 0, 'left') + h.arrow(455, 369, 0, 'straight') + h.car(345, 438, 0, 'blue', 'JIJ') + h.car(455, 438, 0, 'white') + h.tree(640, 70, 43) + h.building(82, 45, 120, 75),
    'Zuidelijke tak is hier expliciet eenrichtingsaanvoer met twee noordwaartse voorsorteerstroken; eigen strook heeft alleen linksafpijl.');
  return records;
}

module.exports = { symbols, files, questions };

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="800" height="500" role="img"><title>Schematische illustratie bij voorrang, kruispunten en voorrangsregels.
